jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon 1P Credito
jobs.description:
Are you excited about building the future of digital lending at massive scale? Do you want to design and build systems that power credit experiences for millions of customers in one of the world's largest and fastest-growing fintech markets?

The Credit & Lending team at Amazon Pay is building Amazon's next-generation lending platform to enable seamless credit experiences for millions of customers across Latin America. We are looking for a strong Software Development Engineer to join our Brazil engineering team and build highly scalable, resilient lending systems from the ground up.

This is a greenfield opportunity. You'll design and deliver critical components of the lending platform including underwriting, loan servicing, repayments, regulatory reporting, and customer-facing experiences. You'll work with latest fintech challenges: real-time decisioning, payment orchestration, compliance automation, and financial data integrity at scale.

This role is ideal for an engineer who wants deep ownership, loves solving hard technical problems, and is energized by the ambiguity and pace of building something new in a regulated, high-stakes domain.

What You'll Do
Design and build core services for the 1P Lending platform in Brazil—spanning underwriting, servicing, repayments, accounting, and compliance.
Write high-quality, production-ready code for backend and Frontend services, with a focus on reliability, testability, and operational excellence.
Own system architecture decisions for your area—API design, data modeling, event-driven flows, and integration patterns with internal and external partners.
Build for compliance—implement systems that meet Brazilian financial regulations (Central Bank reporting, PIX, Open Finance) with auditability and data integrity baked in.
Operate what you build—own monitoring, alarming, on-call, and incident response for your services. Drive high availability and low-latency targets.
Solve ambiguous problems—break down complex business and regulatory requirements into clean, extensible technical solutions.
Collaborate cross-functionally—work closely with product, finance, tax, risk, legal, and partner integration teams to translate requirements into working systems.
Contribute to platform reuse—build shared libraries, frameworks, and architectural patterns that enable scaling across LATAM markets.
Raise the bar—participate actively in code reviews, design reviews, and hiring. Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team culture.

A day in the life
Own a critical product pillar of the 1P Lending platform in Brazil (define the product vision, technical strategy, and execution roadmap.
Work with a team of 7-8 SDEs, setting a high bar for engineering excellence, code quality, operational rigor, and customer obsession.
Be an engineering voice on the ground, driving local execution while staying tightly connected to the broader LATAM and global platform teams.
Design and build highly scalable, resilient, and secure distributed systems for real-time underwriting, loan servicing, repayments, accounting, and compliance.
Drive technical decisions on architecture, API design, data modeling, and system integration with internal services and external financial partners.
Navigate regulatory and compliance complexity—partner with legal, finance, tax, and risk teams to build technology that meets Brazilian financial regulations (Central Bank, PIX, Open Finance).
Establish operational excellence—own system availability, latency, monitoring, alarming, on-call processes, and incident management for your product area.
Influence the broader platform by contributing reusable components, shared libraries, and cross-market architectural patterns.

jobs.title: Device Software Engineer, Amazon Leo Government
jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

We are breaking new ground with every device we design, from custom silicon to secure software, to enable innovative satellite and ground systems. Be part of a team that pushes the boundaries of satellite communications technology to make global connectivity a reality.

As an Device Software Development Engineer on the Amazon Leo Government (ALG) team, you will design and develop embedded software for Amazon Leo’s satellite and ground systems. You’ll work on fault-tolerant, real-time platforms, collaborating closely with hardware, systems, and product teams to deliver secure, reliable, and high-performance solutions.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the next generation of space-based communication systems with minimal legacy constraints. Your work will directly support critical government initiatives, enabling secure and high-performance communication systems for U.S. and allied missions.

This role can sit in either Northridge, El Segundo, or Arlington with U.S. relocation benefits offered. On-site work is required 5 days a week.

Key job responsibilities
• Design, develop, and optimize embedded software for Amazon Leo's satellite and ground terminal systems, focusing on fault-tolerant, real-time platforms.
• Leverage modern application frameworks for Embedded Linux and RTOS platforms to develop scalable, modular, and high-performance software.
• Implement and integrate software for data processing, device control, and networking protocols (e.g., TCP/IP, UDP).
• Debug and resolve complex hardware-software integration issues using tools like logic analyzers and oscilloscopes.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless hardware-software interaction and system reliability.
• Mentor junior engineers, conduct design reviews, and uphold high software quality standards.

Export Control : This position requires that the candidate selected be a U.S. Citizen in order to comply with U.S. government-imposed requirements related to the nature of the work and/or where it will be performed.

About the team
Amazon Leo Government (ALG) is a multidisciplinary team developing targeted and scalable solutions for custom satellite and ground applications. ALG Device Software focuses on embedded software solutions for custom products supporting U.S. and allied government customers. We collaborate closely with hardware and systems teams to deliver secure, high-performance solutions for mission-critical applications.

jobs.description:
We are looking for an Embedded Software Development Engineer to join the RBKS ASIC team, building firmware and diagnostics software that enables silicon bring-up, production testing, and product integration for Ring's custom SoCs. ASIC bring-up is a hardware + software co-debug exercise. This role ensures we have dedicated firmware engineering capability on-site to resolve silicon issues without round-trip delays, directly reducing bring-up

Key job responsibilities
Develop and maintain silicon bring-up diagnostics and production test software
• Write low-level drivers and BSP code for custom ASIC peripherals (boot ROM, memory controllers, communication interfaces)
• Support on-site bring-up at contract manufacturers (Vietnam, China) and Ring Taipei
• Assist product teams with firmware integration, boot sequence validation, and peripheral bring-up
• Debug software-related silicon issues during EVT/DVT/PVT phases through register-level analysis
• Develop automated test scripts and diagnostic tools for ATE and bench validation
• Collaborate with the hardware team to define and execute hardware-software co-validation plans
• Contribute to production test flow development ensuring manufacturing quality and yield

You'll work hands-on with early silicon—writing the first code that runs on a new chip, debugging boot failures, and building the diagnostic suite that validates every peripheral.

About the team
We're a small, nimble ASIC team building Ring's custom silicon from the ground up. We work in a vertically integrated environment where you see your work directly impact the products millions of customers rely on daily.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Billing Data Services
jobs.description:
We make AWS billing data trustworthy at the source. As a Software Development Engineer II on the Billing Data Services (BiDS) team, you will build and operate the foundational systems that capture, store, and serve the billing facts that AWS billing services rely on.

Our services sit upstream of bill computation systems. We ingest billing data from across AWS (such as pricing, subscriptions, and entitlements), persist it as a single source of truth, and serve it to the teams and pipelines that join it with usage to synthesize customer-facing billing artifacts. We operate at the scale of all of AWS, where correctness is non-negotiable and a single bad record can ripple into thousands of customer bills.

As a senior software engineer on this team, you will lead the technical direction for large-scale distributed systems built on AWS services. You will design durable storage and serving paths, and build the data layer that hundreds of AWS teams depend on. Your work will impact millions of external customers and sit on the critical path of Billing.

Key job responsibilities
- Design high-quality, efficient, and testable code in Java and other object-oriented languages.
- Build large-scale, highly available distributed systems for ingesting, storing, and serving authoritative billing data at the scale of all of AWS.
- Design storage and serving paths that meet demanding freshness, accuracy, and latency requirements for downstream billing pipelines.
- Partner with downstream teams on schema and data contract changes, making sure migrations are backward compatible and do not disrupt their pipelines.
- Own and operate the systems you build, holding a high bar for data quality, correctness, and operational rigor.
- Contribute to planning, design, implementation, testing, operations, and process improvement as a member of a Scrum team.
- Collaborate with product managers and engineers across Commerce Platform teams to deliver features and drive the adoption of best practices.

A day in the life
You might start the morning reviewing ingestion and data quality dashboards before joining a design review for a new storage or serving path. By midday, you are working with a downstream team on a schema or data contract change, making sure the migration is backward compatible and won't disrupt their pipelines. In the afternoon, you are deep in an approach to cut serving latency or raise ingestion throughput, then aligning with a partner team on an upstream event format change. You balance long-term platform investments with the immediate needs of the teams that depend on your data.

About the team
We own the systems that hold and serve the authoritative billing facts for AWS Commerce Platform services. BiDS delivers timely and consistent operational billing data to support near real-time bill computation and cost and usage monitoring for AWS, giving billing teams a high-performance, queryable, and cost-effective data layer to store and access operational billing data.

Because we sit upstream of the bill computation systems, our data quality and freshness affect SLAs for the systems downstream. We treat correctness and operational rigor as first principles, but we move quickly when downstream teams and customers need us. We solve problems at the intersection of large-scale data systems, durable storage, and the trust customers place in their bill. This is a space where being right matters more than anything, and where the data we own touches every Billing team.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, Geospatial
jobs.description:
Join Amazon's Last Mile Geospatial Technology team and help build the intelligence layer that powers millions of deliveries every day.

The Geospatial organization within Last Mile Technology owns the foundational location and mapping systems that Amazon Logistics depends on — from geocoding and address resolution to delivery accuracy and spatial analytics. The team is also responsible for closing the loop between delivery outcomes and geospatial data quality, driving continuous improvement across the delivery network.

We're building an agentic system that automatically investigates delivery issues, correlates signals across geocode data, address metadata, delivery patterns and history, and produces actionable insights at scale. Think of it as an always-on geospatial analyst that can trace a wrong-to-address delivery back through layers of spatial data, identify root causes, and recommend fixes — all without human intervention.

This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of geospatial systems, data engineering, and agentic AI. You won't just be writing CRUD APIs — you'll be designing autonomous investigation workflows, building correlation engines across heterogeneous spatial datasets, and creating systems that reason about real-world delivery problems.


Key job responsibilities
- Design and build core components of the agent — investigation pipelines, signal correlation logic, and automated root-cause analysis workflows
- Work with geospatial data at scale: geocodes, address graphs, delivery traces, proof-of-delivery signals, and map layers
- Build integrations with internal geospatial platforms to power automated lookups and analysis
- Develop data pipelines that ingest, transform, and connect delivery outcome data with spatial quality metrics
- Collaborate with applied scientists and geospatial engineers to translate investigation heuristics into scalable, automated systems
- Own your services end-to-end — from design through deployment, monitoring, and operational excellence
- Define system architectures and designs, exploring technical feasibility tradeoffs, and making data-driven decisions.
- Help drive the architecture and technology choices that enable a world-class experience

A day in the life
As an SDE on GeoLoop, you'll build Chronicles — an agentic system that automatically investigates delivery issues by reasoning across Amazon's geospatial data. Day-to-day, you'll design autonomous investigation workflows, write correlation logic connecting geocode quality and delivery outcomes, and ship features that directly reduce wrong deliveries. You'll collaborate with applied scientists, geospatial engineers, and operations teams who rely on your system to surface root causes at scale. The end customer is the Amazon delivery customer — every automated investigation improves the spatial data that powers their experience. Small team, end-to-end ownership, real architectural influence.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Fuse
jobs.description:
Would you like to be part of a team that is solving new business challenges through innovative technology?

The Team: The Fuse tech team is an innovative and high-energy team that is working on Amazon Fuse, a wholesale subscription service that enables 3rd party enterprises with billing and distribution capabilities. Fuse has created a one stop integration point for service teams (e.g. Prime, Music, Video, more) to be able to offer their subscription services through the top global partners who collectively offer subscriber billing services to more than 4B consumers. While we use existing Amazon systems when possible, you’ll be working on challenging problems that need innovative solutions.

As a key member of our team, you will have the opportunity to work directly enabling new external vendor on Amazon marketplaces, owning major deliverables across all aspects of development: scoping, design, implementation, and testing. Successful candidates can multi-task, quickly adapt to new development environments, learn new systems, create reliable/maintainable code, and find creative and scalable solutions to difficult problems.

The ideal candidate is excited about technology and passionate about learning and should view every customer interaction as an opportunity to create an exceptional customer experience. Everyone on the team needs to be entrepreneurial, excited to work in a “green field”. The right candidate will wear many hats and work in a highly collaborative environment that is more startup than big company.

Key job responsibilities
The Role: As a Software Development Engineer, you will work with a team of talented engineers to build low-latency solutions for frontend, middle tier and backend as well as identify and evaluate new technology options for the challenges we are trying to solve. You will work with a variety of core languages, microservices, and technologies including Java, Dynamo DB, Lambda, SQS, SNS and many other AWS services. A team owns multiple product line end to end.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer II, Autonomy Platform, Data and Tools
jobs.description:
The Amazon Robotics Autonomous Mobility software team develops the autonomy software that powers Proteus, Amazon’s first fully autonomous warehouse robot. We are growing and are looking for a Software Development Engineer to join our Platform, Data and Tools team.

You will be part of an exceptional group of engineers building the platform and architecture for our onboard mapping, perception, motion planning and control software. In addition, you will collaborate with engineers and scientists across the team to develop and enhance our ML training and deployment pipelines.

Key job responsibilities
Specific areas of focus may include (but are not limited too):

- Optimizing runtime performance of core algorithms by exploiting underlying hardware acceleration capabilities
- Integrating new sensors and hardware components into the autonomy software stack
- Developing and customizing our Nvidia Jetpack based platform and OS.
- Developing software to enable remote diagnostics, recovery and control of autonomous robots
- Designing and developing software interfaces to enable hardware testing and manufacturing processes
- Developing embedded middleware to accelerate the development of other engineering teams
- Mentor other engineer team members

A day in the life
Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
We are a multi-disciplinary organization of collaborative Applied Scientists and Software Engineers with expertise in Computer Vision, SLAM, motion planning, controls, embedded development, and more. Our mission is to deliver autonomous navigation software that utilizes state-of-the-art sensor technologies and algorithms to enable safe and efficient operation of autonomous mobile robots throughout the Amazon fulfillment and transportation network. We take this mission seriously and work hard to achieve it, but we have a lot of fun along the way. After all, what's more fun than building robots?

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II , Amazon Cross Border Tech
jobs.description:
The Amazon Cross Border Core Technology team is seeking a seasoned Software Engineer to drive the development of innovative technologies that will shape platforms and products impacting a multibillion-dollar business and enhancing the global customer experience. Our team is focused on building next-generation services that will transform international trade at Amazon. We aim to revolutionize how shoppers worldwide discover and purchase global products. We’re developing new services in areas like Customer Returns, Accounting, Customer Service and Mobile App to enhance the international shopping experience. Our goal is to offer a seamless, one-stop shopping experience for international customers, which includes:

Building products (mobile and web based) that reach millions of new customers globally, delivering a world-class shopping experience with localized language, payment options, and currencies.
Designing API-based services in NAWS that enable scalable platforms for both internal and external partners.
Advancing customer experience technologies to support shoppers worldwide.
Innovating strategies for global expansion and developing solutions that will sustain the continued rapid growth of this thriving business.

Key job responsibilities
You’re seeking a career where you can create, deliver, and make a lasting impact. You design solutions that reach millions of new customers globally, addressing complex problems with a holistic approach. You thrive in environments that demand intricate feedback loops and the development of robust ecosystems. You’re passionate about solving real-world challenges with creative and thoughtful solutions, leveraging a deep understanding of the problem space. You constantly challenge yourself and others to improve, always striving for better outcomes. By collaborating closely with the business, you help define expansion strategies and develop innovative solutions that support the continued rapid growth of this dynamic and thriving business.

About the team
We're going to enable customers around the globe to purchase products on Amazon with guaranteed shipping and import duty fees. We’re going to improve this experience by making selection available across all Amazon marketplaces, so that customers can search and browse in their preferred language and currency. Along the way, we're going to face seemingly impossible problems. We're going to argue about how to solve them, and we'll work together to find a solution that is superior to each of the proposals we came in with. We'll make tough decisions, but we'll all understand why. We'll be the dream team.

jobs.title: Satellite RF Test SW Dev Engineer, Amazon Leo
jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

Innovation is part of our DNA! Our goal is to be Earth's most customer centric company, and we are just getting started. We need people who want to join an ambitious program that continues to push the state of the art in space based systems design.

Key job responsibilities
You should be comfortable with a high degree of ambiguity and relish the idea of solving problems that haven't been solved at scale before. Along the way, we guarantee that you will learn a lot, have fun and make a positive impact on tens of millions of people.
In this role, you will:
• Architect and build software to automate hardware test systems
• Develop software infrastructure to support test case execution
• Architect and build automation to support development (CI/CD)
• Align with various stakeholders on software requirements
• Document software requirements from users
• Support manufacturing as well as new product development
• Enable automated data collection, data analysis
• Deliver end-user documents
• Own and execute software quality and release process
• Work with electrical test equipment


Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

A day in the life
You will have the opportunity to write software to test exciting products and help us bring our idea to reality. Your software will enable the team to validate our designs and ensure all our hardware is space-worthy. You will make daily decision on how to best create and deliver these tools.

About the team
This Satellite RF Test SW Dev Engineer will have the opportunity to be a member of the Satellite RF Hardware Design Team working within the wider Amazon Leo RF and Modem team. This highly collaborative group of engineers has a diverse range of backgrounds and knowledge and looking for help to build a scalable and reliable test automation solution for 1st and 2nd gen Leo satellites. The team supports design validation test, space qualification test, and production test of spacecraft gigabit speed modems, millimeter-wave amplifiers, frequency converters and LNAs. They like to leverage and share work across the entire organization as well as utilize AWS resources and tools to accelerate their work.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Ads Campaign Management
jobs.description:
Amazon Advertising is one of Amazon's fastest growing and most profitable businesses, responsible for defining and delivering AI-powered solutions that transform how advertisers make strategic decisions. We deliver billions of ad impressions and process massive volumes of advertiser data every single day. You'll work with us to pioneer breakthrough approaches in how AI agents access and reason over real-time advertiser data at scale.

The Campaign Management team is responsible for capturing inputs for advertisers to control their advertising efforts. You can think of our team as the brain and nervous system of all the advertisements you see on amazon.com. We build large scale, high velocity distributed systems to service 100’s of millions of API requests per day, steam data at PB scale, process business logic on tight latency budgets, all while streaming and the data at high fidelity to 20+ other services to perform other critical advertising functions. We stand up world class CI/CD pipelines to deploy our service automating infrastructure provisioning, high volume load testing and first-rate monitoring so our engineers can keep their heads down inventing for our advertisers. Our problem space covers concurrent workflows across distributed systems (linearizability, eventual consistency), big data problems (propagation delay, ordering and hygiene) and performance (search optimization). Our team uses the latest AWS products and services to solve our problems including but not limited to: ECS, Fargate, EC2, EMR, Lambda, Kafka, Elastic Search, Dynamo DB, SQS, SNS, Cloud watch, CDK, Cloud Formation and many more.

We are using generative AI and agentic systems to help advertising agents provide instant, strategic advice to millions of advertisers. You will need to invent new techniques for global ads experience, agent orchestration, and context optimization to ensure we're delivering accurate, trustworthy insights with minimal latency and token consumption. You'll create feedback loops to ensure our solutions are constantly evaluating themselves and improving.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement scalable architectures for APIs serving millions of advertisers at thousands of transactions per second
- Build Model Context Protocol (MCP) server infrastructure—an emerging standard for AI agent-data interaction—that delivers advertiser context with sub-second latency and minimal token consumption
- Establish system design patterns and best practices for global ads experience at scale

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
jobs.description:
At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

ABOUT THIS ROLE
As a Senior Software Development Engineer on the Fraud Defense Engineering team, you will be at the forefront of protecting Audible's ecosystem — safeguarding creators, listeners, and customers from fraud and abuse across all global marketplaces. You'll design and build intelligent detection systems, investigation platforms, and automated enforcement capabilities that operate at scale. This is a high-impact role where your technical decisions directly protect the integrity of our business and the trust of millions of customers worldwide.
You'll drive the team forward — anticipating threats before they materialize, innovating on detection approaches, and leading the way to develop original, effective solutions. We'll support you with the latest technologies, tools, and systems you need to succeed.

ABOUT THE TEAM
The Fraud Defense Engineering team sits within Audible's inSpire organization. We build the tooling, platforms, and automated systems that protect the integrity and trustworthiness of Audible's business. Our primary focus areas include:
- Creator Fraud — detecting and preventing fraudulent content and manipulation of royalty systems
- Anti-Piracy — engineering protections against unauthorized distribution and content theft
- Consumer Fraud — identifying and mitigating account abuse, payment fraud, and promotional exploitation
We are also experts in ensuring that Audible meets its data handling and customer privacy obligations across all marketplaces. Joining our team provides the unique challenge and opportunity to deliver software that benefits customers around the world.

ABOUT YOU
You're in your element when you're being challenged, and you're always eager to share your ideas, take on responsibility, and keep developing at an exciting pace. You show initiative, set your standards high, and see every failure as an opportunity to learn. You're looking for an environment where you can thrive, influence technical direction, and help your team reach their potential.

As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you will...
- Independently lead complex technical initiatives within the fraud defense domain
- Design and build scalable fraud detection systems, such as rule engines, ML-based anomaly detection, and risk scoring pipelines
- Architect real-time and batch data processing systems to aggregate fraud signals across multiple marketplaces
- Adapt and Build investigation and case management tools that empower internal operations teams
- Partner with data scientists, product managers, and policy teams to define enforcement strategies
- Mentor and support other developers by cultivating curiosity and deep technical understanding
- Write technical design documents and drive alignment across teams
- Establish and follow good engineering practices, balancing speed of enforcement with customer experience
- Collaborate effectively across time zones with distributed teams

ABOUT AUDIBLE
Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

A day in the life

jobs.title: Sr. SDE, Affordability and Hardline Fulfillment Experiences
jobs.description:
The Affordability and Category Experiences Tech team plays a pivotal role in building technology that enhances customer trust, delivers the lowest cost of buying, improved delivery speed, and reduces business waste. We are committed to ensuring the lowest upfront cost for customers and a best-in-class experience from the moment an order is placed on Amazon to the moment it arrives at the customer's doorstep. True innovation is in our DNA.

We are looking for a Sr. Software Development Engineer with the expertise and passion to imagine, build, and deliver innovative products at scale. This is a high-growth space and a significant opportunity that demands a builder's mindset. You are naturally curious, detail-oriented, motivated by challenging environments, and comfortable thinking big while diving deep into the details. This is a unique opportunity for a technical leader driven to pioneer India's first global innovation in a fast-paced, high-impact environment.
If you are looking for an opportunity to own an end-to-end technology stack, leverage AI and build creative solutions that drive high business and customer impact, and thrive on ownership - join our team today!

Role Overview

This role involves the design, architecture, implementation, and operation of large-scale cloud systems. You will autonomously define the technical direction of these services and shape the feature roadmap. You will collaborate with extraordinary talent and have the opportunity to hire and build the team that best executes on the product vision. This role would expose you to solving problems of scale in the areas of distributed systems of cloud-scale, large scale data processing, Agentic AI.


Key job responsibilities

As a Sr. Software Development Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the definition, vision, design, roadmap, and development of core applications and services within the Affordability and Category Experiences engineering team. You will:

• Work closely with a cross-functional team of engineers (mobile, front-end, backend) including Principals, product managers, designers, and marketers
• Design, test, learn, and iterate on solutions in a fast-paced environment
• Own the technical architecture and drive system design decisions for large-scale distributed systems
• Lead and mentor engineers, and drive best practices using AI driven SDLC around design, coding, testability, and security

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, IAM, Authorization Management
jobs.description:
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

What do you know about protecting sensitive data? What about fine-grained access control (FGAC) on Big Data? Or attribute-based access control (ABAC) and context based authorization? What about catching bad actors that are abusing Amazon services? Or attacks that could potentially lead to a widespread data breach? Do you know how to generate activity-based intelligence (ABI) through anomaly detection?

In Security Products we build Access Policy Management systems to enable all Amazon teams to apply FGAC to their sensitive data. We build products that apply context based authorization to solve the problem of over-permissioning. We apply Machine Learning Techniques in our Monitored Access (MA) abuse detection program to preemptively detect and mitigate internal and external malicious actors. We do this to protect Amazon customer, seller, vendor and employee information across from constantly changing abuse actor behaviors and patterns.

In our newly created organization we have a rare opportunity to engage with multiple Amazon organizations and groups of experienced tech leaders to build products with impact at an impressive scale (hundreds of thousands of services).

We are looking for enthusiastic Software Development Engineers with strong analytical and problem solving skills, who will participate in full development cycle for mission critical systems. You will work with leading-edge technologies and tools, on innovative and sophisticated features, collaborate with your team and its leadership to drive key engineering and business decisions that will enhance the Amazon’s security posture. You will contribute to all parts of the software development and deployment lifecycle, including design, implementation, documentation, testing and operations.

Key job responsibilities
- Your work focuses on delivering software features and improvements to major portions of your team’s software. This is not just new software but often includes refactoring and deprecation work.
- You work on difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks. You bring clarity to problems and identify simple designs for solutions.
- You design software solutions to enable new features or improve software. You may still require guidance from your team’s leadership to ensure your designs are in alignment with your team’s long-term architectural strategy.
- You are a significant contributor to the full software development lifecycle, including scoping, design, code, testing, deployment and maintenance of the team's software.
- You are active in the code review process on your team, providing meaningful feedback to others, including those who are more senior.
- You document what your team’s software does; how it is constructed, tested, and operated; how secure it is; and how it fits into the bigger picture. When new teammates join, you actively train them in these points.
- Your work positively impacts the software quality, customer experience, and maintainability of your team’s product(s). You are starting to balance customer requirements with team requirements.

About the team
Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training and Career growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer , Annapurna Labs
jobs.description:
Annapurna Labs, an Amazon company, is at the forefront of cloud infrastructure innovation. Our team designs custom silicon that powers the world's largest cloud — from Graviton processors and Nitro security chips to Trainium and Inferentia machine learning accelerators.

We are a multidisciplinary engineering organization where hardware meets software at a massive scale. Our chips and systems run millions of workloads across AWS, and our low-level software is the critical layer that brings this silicon to life. Joining Annapurna Labs means working on technology that shapes the future of cloud computing.

Key job responsibilities
We are looking for talented Software Development Engineers to join our teams in Tel Aviv or Haifa and work on low-level software development. You will be building the foundational software layers that sit closest to the hardware — enabling high performance, reliability, and efficiency for AWS services at an unprecedented scale.

This is an opportunity to work in a deeply technical environment where your code runs on custom-designed silicon, directly impacting the performance and cost of cloud infrastructure used by millions of customers worldwide.

Design, develop, and optimize low-level software including device drivers, firmware, and hardware abstraction layers

Collaborate closely with hardware design teams to define hardware-software interfaces and bring-up new silicon

Write performance-critical systems software in C/C++ that operates under strict latency and resource constraints

Debug complex hardware-software interactions

Contribute to system architecture decisions and define software design patterns for next-gen chip features

Develop and maintain automated test frameworks to validate functionality and performance at scale

Participate in code reviews and drive engineering best practices within the team

A day in the life
Your Path to Embedded

This role is also an excellent opportunity for experienced software engineers looking to transition into embedded and low-level development. If you come from a general software engineering background — backend services, distributed systems, cloud applications — and are curious about what happens beneath the abstractions, this is your chance to make the move.

We invest in engineers who are eager to learn. You will receive:

Structured onboarding with a dedicated mentor from the hardware-software boundary team

Hands-on ramp-up: start with well-defined driver modules and gradually expand to architecture-level contributions

Pairing with experienced embedded engineers

What matters most is strong C/C++ skills, a debugging mindset, and genuine curiosity about how systems work at the lowest level. You don't need to know everything on day one — we'll help you get there.

jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer - Embedded Development (Linux), Amazon Linux

Do you want to solve real customer problems through innovative technology? Do you enjoy working on scalable services in a collaborative team environment? Do you want to see your code directly impact millions of customers worldwide?

Our Software Development Engineers (SDEs) use modern technology to solve complex problems while seeing their work's impact first-hand. The challenges SDEs solve at Amazon are meaningful and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products globally. We seek individuals passionate about creating new products, features, and services while managing ambiguity in an environment where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years.
At Amazon, we believe in ownership at every level. As an SDE-I, you'll own the entire lifecycle of your code - from design through deployment and ongoing operations. This ownership mindset, combined with our commitment to operational excellence, ensures we deliver the highest quality solutions for our customers.
We're looking for curious minds who think big and want to define tomorrow's technology. At Amazon, you'll grow into the high-impact engineer you know you can be, supported by a culture of learning and mentorship. Every day brings exciting new challenges and opportunities for personal growth.

- Discover, evaluate, remediate and deploy fixes for Linux security vulnerabilities.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon 1P Credito
jobs.description:
Are you excited about building the future of digital lending at massive scale? Do you want to design and build systems that power credit experiences for millions of customers in one of the world's largest and fastest-growing fintech markets?

The Credit & Lending team at Amazon Pay is building Amazon's next-generation lending platform to enable seamless credit experiences for millions of customers across Latin America. We are looking for a strong Software Development Engineer to join our Brazil engineering team and build highly scalable, resilient lending systems from the ground up.

This is a greenfield opportunity. You'll design and deliver critical components of the lending platform including underwriting, loan servicing, repayments, regulatory reporting, and customer-facing experiences. You'll work with latest fintech challenges: real-time decisioning, payment orchestration, compliance automation, and financial data integrity at scale.

This role is ideal for an engineer who wants deep ownership, loves solving hard technical problems, and is energized by the ambiguity and pace of building something new in a regulated, high-stakes domain.

What You'll Do
Design and build core services for the 1P Lending platform in Brazil—spanning underwriting, servicing, repayments, accounting, and compliance.
Write high-quality, production-ready code for backend and Frontend services, with a focus on reliability, testability, and operational excellence.
Own system architecture decisions for your area—API design, data modeling, event-driven flows, and integration patterns with internal and external partners.
Build for compliance—implement systems that meet Brazilian financial regulations (Central Bank reporting, PIX, Open Finance) with auditability and data integrity baked in.
Operate what you build—own monitoring, alarming, on-call, and incident response for your services. Drive high availability and low-latency targets.
Solve ambiguous problems—break down complex business and regulatory requirements into clean, extensible technical solutions.
Collaborate cross-functionally—work closely with product, finance, tax, risk, legal, and partner integration teams to translate requirements into working systems.
Contribute to platform reuse—build shared libraries, frameworks, and architectural patterns that enable scaling across LATAM markets.
Raise the bar—participate actively in code reviews, design reviews, and hiring. Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team culture.

A day in the life
Own a critical product pillar of the 1P Lending platform in Brazil (define the product vision, technical strategy, and execution roadmap.
Work with a team of 7-8 SDEs, setting a high bar for engineering excellence, code quality, operational rigor, and customer obsession.
Be an engineering voice on the ground, driving local execution while staying tightly connected to the broader LATAM and global platform teams.
Design and build highly scalable, resilient, and secure distributed systems for real-time underwriting, loan servicing, repayments, accounting, and compliance.
Drive technical decisions on architecture, API design, data modeling, and system integration with internal services and external financial partners.
Navigate regulatory and compliance complexity—partner with legal, finance, tax, and risk teams to build technology that meets Brazilian financial regulations (Central Bank, PIX, Open Finance).
Establish operational excellence—own system availability, latency, monitoring, alarming, on-call processes, and incident management for your product area.
Influence the broader platform by contributing reusable components, shared libraries, and cross-market architectural patterns.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AppSTAR COMPASS
jobs.description:
Write the code behind the system that decides how security attention gets spent. You'll join a brand-new team building at Amazon scale, on a platform that evaluates every code change tens of thousands of engineers ship and clears the vast majority without a human ever touching it.

Security review has always been a bottleneck. A developer ships a change, waits for someone to look at it, and the security team drowns in a queue it can never fully clear. We're ending that tradeoff. Our engine evaluates changes as they happen, decides how much scrutiny each one actually needs, and handles the common case automatically: no wait for the developer, no queue for the reviewer.

The team is funded and forming now, which means you'll be building features on a system that doesn't exist yet rather than maintaining one that does. You'll have senior engineers to learn from on the design side and security engineers backing you with the risk expertise, so you're building against what actually matters instead of guessing. If you want your code to be the reason a security review takes zero minutes instead of two weeks, come build it.

- Own real features on a greenfield platform, end to end
- Work on agentic and automated evaluation running continuously at high volume
- Learn the security side from engineers who do it every day


Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, test, deploy, and operate features of the platform that evaluates code changes for security risk and routes the ones that need a human.
- Own your features across their full lifecycle, from working out what the customer actually needs through production operation and the documentation that lets someone else maintain it.
- Write code that meets a high bar for correctness, testing, security, and operability, and keep it that way as the system grows.
- Build and tune automated evaluation logic, including agentic checks, working with the security engineers who understand what the checks need to catch.
- Partner with senior engineers on design, bringing them the hard tradeoffs and clarifying requirements that arrive incomplete.
- Participate actively in code review, giving useful feedback to teammates at every level.
- Take part in operational support and on-call. When something breaks, find the root cause and fix it permanently rather than patching around it.
- Document how your software works, how it's operated, and how it fits the bigger picture, and help new teammates get up to speed on it.
- Look for the improvements nobody asked for: the flaky test, the manual step, the slow path.

A day in the life
Most of your day is designing and writing code on a system that's still taking shape. You'll pick up a feature, work out the approach, take the tricky parts to a senior engineer or a design review, then build it and ship it. Some days you're deep in why a class of change is getting evaluated wrong at volume. Others you're on operational support, chasing a root cause. You'll sit with security engineers to understand what your code needs to catch, and review your teammates' code as often as they review yours.

About the team
We decide how security attention gets spent, automatically. Our customers are the engineers shipping code every day and the security engineers reviewing it, and right now both pay a tax we think is avoidable. Our job is to remove it. We're brand new, small, and close enough to the outcome that you'll see your work land. We hold a high bar on code and operations because automated decisions have to be trustworthy, and we'd rather encode expertise into a mechanism than depend on one person holding it.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer, AWS Managed Backend Services
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building the next generation of fully-managed backend services that let developers go from idea to production in minutes? Do you want to work at the intersection of databases, authentication, real-time infrastructure, and AI-assisted development enabling millions of developers (and their AI coding agents) to ship applications without managing servers, schemas, or infrastructure?

We are building a new opinionated backend platform within AWS that unifies database, authentication and other functions into a single, cohesive developer experience. Our mission is to remove the undifferentiated heavy lifting of standing up a production backend. This is a greenfield opportunity to define how the next wave of AI-native applications are built on AWS.

Key job responsibilities
- Control Plane Architecture: Design and build the scalable, multi-tenant control plane that orchestrates provisioning, lifecycle management, and configuration of backend resources across regions.

- Database & Storage Services: Architect and implement managed relational database capabilities, including schema management, migrations, row-level security, and real-time change data capture on top ofexisting databases engines.

- Authentication & Authorization: Build production-grade identity and access management services including OAuth/OIDC flows, social login, JWT management, row-level security policies, and multi-tenant isolation.
- AI-Native Developer Experience: Define how AI coding assistants, autonomous agents, and MCP-based toolchains interact with the platform: building SDKs, CLI tools, and introspection endpoints optimized for agentic workflows.
- Technical Leadership: Lead multi-engineer projects, drive design reviews, mentor engineers, and influence the team's technical roadmap.

After lunch you sit down to write the code with your agent of choice and review changes and ship it by end of day, either in TypeScript or Rust.

We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating, that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Route 53 Global Resolver, AWS Route 53 Global Resolver
jobs.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

AWS Route 53 Resolver team has an open position for Software Development Engineer for Cloud security service development in Arlington, VA / Herndon, VA / Seattle, WA, USA.

We’re looking for a mid-level Software Development Engineer to join the Amazon Route 53 Global Resolver team. Our team builds and operates a globally distributed DNS resolution service that enables AWS customers to securely resolve internal and external DNS names across regions, networks, and hybrid environments. You will help ensure that DNS queries are resolved securely, reliably, and within milliseconds for enterprise customers running workloads across VPCs, on-prem, and edge locations.

As an SDE, This is a rare opportunity to build a new AWS service from its preview launch toward global scale. You will work across the entire stack—control plane, data plane, API surfaces, and deep integrations with AGA, EC2 Networking, DNS Firewall, and Route 53 core systems. You will also help drive the system architecture, spearhead best practices that enable a quality product, and help coach and develop junior engineers. A successful candidate will have an established background in engineering large scale networking software, great communication skills, and a motivation to achieve results in a fast paced environment.

At Amazon Web Services, we like to “work backwards”: start by understanding what customers need and using that to guide our software engineering. We’re looking for a software engineer who is experienced in listening to customers, synthesizing their needs, and rapidly iterating our services to quickly put features into customers’ hands. Our best ideas become even better when we get feedback from real customer use. The sooner we can get that feedback, the more quickly we can grow.

This position will be part of the Amazon Route 53 team. Amazon Route 53 is a highly available and scalable Domain Name System (DNS) service offered by Amazon Web Services. We operate in over 50 locations worldwide and provide advanced functionality such as Private DNS, DNS Firewall, DNS resolver and integration with a plethora of AWS services. On top of that, we offer fast change propagation with a 100% availability SLA. Our service is quickly growing and we're expanding in multiple directions: adding new features and functionality to our DNS services, better traffic management, new AWS integrations, improving our health check capabilities, and expanding with new security services and routing space.

We work on deep, technical problems that span a variety of core topics in computer science ranging from databases to networking to distributed systems to numerical analysis to security. We are looking for a developer who will lead the team and who feels strongly not only about building good software but also about running that software in the real world.

Amazon in a fast-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun, Make History.” On a typical day, software engineers might whip up a prototype to prove an idea, instrument code to report a new metric, talk with customers, code up a feature, or draft a proposal for a radical new idea.

We are open to hiring candidates to work out of one of the following locations:

Vancouver, BC, Canada

jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer, Antenna System Validation
jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

As a Software Development Engineer on antenna systems validation team, you'll build the software backbone that powers our satellite ground infrastructure. You'll work at the intersection of distributed systems, automation, and hardware, creating tools that our engineers rely on every day.

Your Impact:
- Build scalable test automation frameworks that validate complex antenna systems at scale
- Design and develop data pipelines for processing and analyzing massive datasets from RF systems
- Create developer tools and APIs that accelerate hardware bring-up and system characterization
- Develop simulation and modeling applications for 2D/3D antenna array design
- Automate everything: from firmware deployment to system configuration and validation
- Build web applications and dashboards for system monitoring and data visualization
- Collaborate across disciplines with systems architects, hardware engineers, and firmware teams

Technologies & Skills:
- Python, Rust, C++, Java, Go, or similar
- Cloud services and distributed systems (AWS preferred)
- Test automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines
- Data processing and storage solutions
- API design and microservices architecture
- Scripting and DevOps practices

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II - Threat Intelligence Systems, ACTI Engineering
jobs.description:
The Amazon Cyber Threat Intelligence (ACTI) organization is responsible for investigating, analyzing, and defending against sophisticated cyber threats targeting Amazon's global businesses and customers. ACTI combines technical expertise, strategic analysis, and advanced tooling to identify emerging threats, track adversary activities, and provide actionable intelligence across Amazon's security ecosystem.

As a Software Development Engineer within ACTI Engineering, you will architect and contribute to the development of mission-critical distributed systems that power Amazon's threat intelligence capabilities. You will make key technical decisions that shape our platform's architecture, designing scalable solutions that process, analyze, and correlate vast amounts of security data across Amazon's global infrastructure. Your technical leadership will directly influence ACTI's ability to detect, analyze, and respond to emerging security threats at scale.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen.



Key job responsibilities
* Own and architect critical components of ACTI's threat intelligence platforms, making key technical decisions that impact system scalability, performance, and reliability
* Design and implement distributed systems that process petabytes of security data
* Lead the development of service-oriented architectures that integrate complex threat intelligence workflows
* Drive technical decisions around data modeling, storage solutions, and processing frameworks
* Own the full software development lifecycle, from design through deployment and operational excellence
* Mentor junior engineers on system design, coding practices, and architectural patterns
* Partner with threat intelligence analysts to translate complex requirements into scalable technical solutions
* Building some of the largest scale intelligence tooling on earth to defend against evolving security threats
* Production incidents and being part of an on-call rotation

Technical Requirements:

* Strong experience designing and implementing distributed systems at scale
* Deep expertise in service-oriented architecture design patterns
* Proven track record of leading technical projects and making architectural decisions
* Strong proficiency in Python and Typescript
* Experience building production-grade applications
* Experience with AWS services and cloud-native architectures
* Demonstrated ability to optimize and scale data processing pipelines
* Experience with monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimizing distributed systems

Threat Intelligence (TI) protects Amazon and its subsidiaries by proactively analyzing new security threats, identifying malicious actors, and researching the evolving threat landscape. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Penrose Networks
jobs.description:
A Software Developer Engineer in Penrose Networks at AWS owns the design and development of key components of Amazon’s next-generation datacenter network.

This includes building tools to provide network visibility to a wide range of internal operators, and systems to automate wiring and incremental expansion of DC networks, globally. You will collaborate with Network Engineering, DC Operations, and with a wide range of teams operating provisioning, configuration, deployment, monitoring and scaling tools.

Key job responsibilities
Develop world-class software systems for automating Amazon's network.
Provide technical direction to the team and identify areas of focus.
Create and review software design documentation
Collaborate with Principal Engineers and Scholars to ensure fast, smooth roll-out of new designs and products.
Own the operational excellence of the software you put into production.
Contribute to improving our documentation, processes, and tools so that we improve our performance as a team.

A day in the life
You will have frontier coding agents with unlimited tokens.

About the team
Penrose Networks is the next-generation datacenter network in AWS. Through a novel architecture based on special mathematical properties, we deliver more resilient, higher-bandwidth, and lower-cost networking compared to the current industry standard. Our team has invented this technology, proven its viability, and driven its adoption across AWS. We are currently working to further enlarge the adoption of this technology to a wider set of use cases and locations.

We are a tiger team. We are disruptors. Our team owns the network, software, and program management aspects that make this next-gen network a reality.

jobs.title: Robot Embedded Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Join the brightest minds in robotics developing the next generation of manipulation robots! You will be part of a multidisciplinary team - a startup within Amazon - breaking new ground in how robots are designed, built and operated at scale. We hire smart and effective engineers and offer them an environment in which they can invent and innovate to improve the experience for our customers. We do this daily by solving complex technical and business problems with ingenuity and simplicity.

As a part of the embedded team, you’ll build advanced control systems for manipulation robots. The stack includes custom hardware, embedded Linux, Computer Vision, Motor Control, WiFi, Safety, IO Protocols for attached devices and more. You will work closely with scientists to design and implement modern controls algorithms. The software you create will be deployed at Amazon scale, powering large fleets.


Key job responsibilities
This brand new system is a critical priority for the Robotics organization. As a key member, you will:

- Design and implement highly reliable embedded control systems
- Develop and optimize real-time control algorithms. Validate designs through simulation and real-world testing
- Partner with roboticists and researchers to implement novel capabilities
- Drive system architecture choices that impact the future of Amazon’s warehouse robotics systems

A day in the life
Amazon offers a full range of benefits to support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:
1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) - Outbound/Flow, AFT Outbound Execution Teams
jobs.description:
Are you seeking an environment where you can apply state-of-the-art computer science techniques, work with latest tools and technologies, and use huge amounts of data to solve real-world problems and make a massive impact? Come and join us in the Outbound group within Amazon Fulfillment Technologies!

Amazon Fulfillment Technologies builds software, hardware, and processes that help tens of thousands of employees deliver billions of items a year from over eighty warehouses worldwide. We ensure that you get what you want when we promised it to you. We are at the core of Amazon's business and our software is mission-critical.

The Outbound Execution group, based in Toronto, creates the software that makes it easy for Amazon staff to safely, quickly and accurately perform the most labour-intensive warehouse function: picking the items for your order. We deal with real physical processes, and our systems need to make decisions within real-time constraints. At our scale, a small optimization can instantly help thousands of staff and save Amazon millions of dollars: savings we can pass on to our customers to keep our prices low. We also have the opportunity to work with the most advanced technologies: AWS, robotics, machine learning, and augmented reality among others.

As a software engineer at Amazon, you're responsible for much more than just writing robust, reliable, scalable and readable code. You will operate a platform where any downtime costs millions. You will work directly with the users of your software, to deeply understand the domain and identify opportunities for improvements and optimizations. We are looking for true engineers that find practical technology solutions to real problems.
Learn more about Amazon's warehouses & software engineering:
