Sellers from Fortune 50 companies to hundreds of thousands of small businesses in 135+ countries rely on FBA, which powers tens of billions in annual GMS across dozens of categories.
Most engineering teams spend their best hours reacting — triaging tickets, babysitting deployments, answering the same operational questions over and over. We're building the opposite team. Our entire charter is to build the AI-native systems that make reactive work disappear: agents that resolve operational issues before a human sees them, self-healing pipelines that deploy without manual gates, and a knowledge foundation that lets software answer for itself. You won't be absorbing FBA's operational load — you'll be engineering it out of existence.
This is a VP-funded, multi-year charter with end-to-end ownership and a leadership-backed mandate. You'll work at the frontier of applied AI — LLM-powered remediation agents, machine-readable operational knowledge, autonomous deployment systems — and see your work adopted across 55+ teams and 500+ engineers. We operate with startup intensity inside Amazon: small teams, fast cycles, and the freedom to invent.

Why this team is different

Build systems, not backlog. Your job is to invent AI-native tooling — not to sit in an operational queue. Your work is measured by how much reactive toil it eliminates for other teams.
AI at the core, not bolted on. You'll ship LLM-powered remediation agents, autonomous workflows, and a knowledge foundation that makes AI-assisted development the default across FBA — real production systems, not prototypes.
Learn from the best. You'll join a dedicated pod with direct access to multiple senior and Principal SDEs for design guidance, code review, and mentorship — with a clear path to grow your scope and visibility on a VP-sponsored charter.
Provable impact. Your systems free up the equivalent of dozens of engineers across FBA — measured, visible, and tied directly to a leadership-backed goal.

Agentic remediation systems — LLM-powered agents that detect, diagnose, and resolve operational issues automatically, replacing manual runbooks with self-executing guidance.
Self-healing deployment platforms — safe primitives, automated integration testing, and pipeline intelligence that drive teams toward fully continuous, hands-off delivery.
The FBA knowledge foundation — the OE infrastructure and knowledge-graph tooling that let AI systems reason about FBA's services and answer operational questions autonomously.

Experience programming with at least one modern language (Java, C++, Python, etc.)
Experience contributing to the architecture and design (design patterns, reliability, scaling) of new and current systems
Experience with the full software development lifecycle — coding standards, code reviews, source control, build processes, testing, and operations

Experience building automation, platform, or developer-productivity systems (CI/CD, observability, agentic/AI-assisted tooling)
Hands-on interest in applying LLMs and AI-native approaches to real engineering problems
Familiarity with continuous delivery and autonomous deployment practices
Bias for measurable impact and comfort inventing in an ambiguous, high-ownership charter

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS - Amazon EKS
jobs.description:
Join the Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) Control Plane team that manage the entire EKS fleet globally. We own the path from a customer's intent to a running cluster: the EKS API that accepts the request, the regional services that hold every cluster's desired state and orchestrate its lifecycle, the services that provision and repair the infrastructure that state describes, and the Kubernetes control plane that runs on it. We also own the availability commitment customers hold us to. And we own knowing what state every cluster is in: the health detection that catches a cluster broken by a change to the resources it depends on, the insights that tell a customer what will break before they upgrade, and the operational signals we stream back to them.

Amazon EKS now supports Kubernetes version rollback, which we built to enable customers mitigate operational risk with in place updates; customers can update normally and watch the new version carry production traffic, and rollback within 7 days if it does not hold, with their cluster state, workloads, and volumes untouched. We also made the control plane resilient to Availability Zone issues with no customer action, which turned a single zonal impairment into a non-event. We run all of this for every EKS cluster across all commercial AWS Regions and AWS GovCloud, and on customer premises through AWS Outposts.

Innovation takes a village, and this team is the catalyst for it. Other EKS teams launch on our API and lifecycle services. AWS partner services like Amazon GuardDuty build customer-facing security features integrating with services we own. We also own the EKS Model Context Protocol server and the AI capabilities that enable how agents work with EKS.

This is an opportunity to operate and engineer distributed systems at scale, and to own the availability and resiliency of a service customers run their production workloads on. You will provide technical leadership and influence strategies to delight our customers. You will be solving challenging technical problems, often ones not solved before, alongside peers with remarkable technical expertise. The solutions you build will be high impact and rolled out to our large customer base across the world. If you are excited to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment to deliver results, we would love to hear from you!

This position involves on-call responsibilities, typically for one week every two months. We don't like getting paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are fault tolerant. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause so that we don't get paged for the same issue again.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Ads Core Services
jobs.description:
Build the real-time, globally distributed platform that controls billing, budgeting, payments, and promotions for Amazon Advertising — processing multi-million transactions worth 100x in dollar value daily with millisecond SLAs, directly impacting the experience of advertisers worldwide. Your work powers the financial levers behind one of Amazon's fastest growing businesses.

The Iron Mountain platform is the singular system managing all advertiser-facing financial functions — billing, invoicing, accounting automation, budgets, promotions, payments, and Billing Advertiser Experience (AX) — in real-time while being transparent and auditable from the ground up. jobs.title: Software Development Manager, PXTCS (People Experience and Technology Central Science)
jobs.description:
Amazon's People Experience and Technology Central Science (PXTCS) team uses economics, behavioral science, statistics, machine learning, and Generative AI to proactively identify mechanisms and process improvements that simultaneously improve Amazon and the lives, well-being, and value of work for Amazonians. PXTCS is an interdisciplinary team that combines the talents of science, engineering, and UX to build and deliver solutions that measurably achieve this goal — at a scale that touches over 1.5 million Amazonians worldwide.

PXTCS is seeking a Software Development Manager to lead an engineering team responsible for taking its most important ML and AI models from research into reliable, large-scale production systems. This person will own the technical strategy, architecture, and operational excellence of the services that serve these models, while building and growing the team of engineers who deliver them.
This is a hands-on leadership role: the SDM will be deep enough in the system to make architectural calls and unblock engineers, while also owning hiring, mentorship, and delivery commitments across the team.

The SDM will work side-by-side with the applied scientists, economists, and data scientists who develop these models, translating research-grade prototypes into production-grade systems that are scalable, efficient, secure, and fault-tolerant. This role partners closely with TPMs, Data Engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders across PXT to ensure the systems built meet real operational needs, and represents the engineering roadmap and technical tradeoffs to senior leadership.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the technical strategy, architecture, and end-to-end delivery of production services that host and serve PXTCS's ML/AI models, ensuring they are scalable, highly available, secure, and fault-tolerant.
- Hire, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of software engineers.
- Partner directly with applied scientists, economists, data engineers and data scientists to take models from research and experimentation through to productionization, establishing repeatable paths from science to production (MLOps, CI/CD, model monitoring, and retraining pipelines).
- Set and maintain engineering standards through design reviews, code reviews, and operational readiness reviews; provide hands-on technical guidance when the team hits hard problems.
- Drive operational excellence for live production systems, including monitoring, alerting, on-call practices, incident response, and root-cause analysis.
- Communicate technical strategy, tradeoffs, risks, and status clearly to both technical teams and senior leadership.
- Collaborate with TPMs, product managers, and business stakeholders across PXT to prioritize roadmap investments against business impact.

jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer - AI Agents, IES LATech
jobs.description:
Amazon is hiring a Software Dev Engineer (Product Engineer) to focus on Agentic AI in Australia, building the capabilities that let AI agents act reliably on real operator workflows. You'll join a specialist team of Product Engineers, Scientists, and Developers within Amazon's emerging-markets technology organization, focused on sustainable growth across Latin America and Australia.

Your customers are operators. Planners, ops managers, analysts, support leads. They make hundreds of small judgement calls a day, and your job is to give them agent capabilities that absorb the repetitive ones so they can focus on the calls that actually matter.

In this role you are part builder, part product owner. You scope the pain, design the mechanism, build the prototype, instrument the metrics, then iterate in production. You build the primitives, integrations, and mechanisms behind agentic systems, integrating large language models with internal data and trading off latency, cost, and accuracy with judgement, not by recipe.

Key job responsibilities
- Review agent runs in production, triage operator corrections, and determine which are bugs versus signal that the autonomy boundary needs to move.
- Pair with operators on workflows you are scoping. Watch them work, ask why behind every step, and translate implicit rules into mechanisms the agent can execute.
- Close the feedback gap by ensuring every operator correction becomes a test, an eval, or a prompt update, not lost noise.
- Own the roadmap end to end. Prioritise, demo weekly, and articulate design choices in writing.
- Partner with operations leaders in each market to identify which workflows are agent-ready and which still need a human in the loop.
- Translate ambiguous operator pain points into concrete, measurable mechanisms with clear success criteria.
- Monitor trust score, accuracy, latency, and cost per decision. Dig into regressions before they compound.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, AWS Catalog
jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides companies of all sizes with an infrastructure web services platform in the cloud. With AWS, you can requisition compute power, storage, and other services – paying as you go for only the resources you need. Within AWS, our Catalog solutions span Glue Data Catalog, Lake Formation, and DataZone. We offer customers a comprehensive inventory of an organization's assets, enrich this view through metadata, and provide data discovery, governance, trust, and query routing functionality. Catalogs are at the forefront of modern Analytics, acting as the bridge between the consumption layer and data services. They effectively enable Engines to query information and allow humans and AI to find semantic meaning in data. Our suite of Catalog services make it easy to set up a secure data lake in days. A data lake is a centralized, curated, and secured repository that stores all your data, both in its original form and prepared for analysis. A data lake enables you to break down data silos and combine different types of analytics to gain insights and guide better business decisions.

Joining the AWS Catalog organization gives you the opportunity to:
- Work on a disruptive product that’s still in its early stages
- Solve challenging problems that will revolutionize database computing in the cloud
- Build a product that will leverage the scale of resources available in the cloud
- Work for a company that’s a recognized leader in the cloud computing space
- Be involved in the fast growing, big data space

We are looking for developers with expertise and passion for building large-scale data-intensive systems and distributed systems. In particular, we are looking for developers that want to work on the next generation big data systems that will transform data management on AWS and across the industry.

Experience with large scale data analytics, big data platforms, highly available/fault tolerant systems, replicated data storage, and operating complex services running in the cloud are all pluses.



Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will have responsibility for:
- Translating functional and technical requirements into detailed architecture and design
- Coding and testing complex system components
- Participating in code and design reviews to maintain our high development standards
- Working with other teams to deliver and operate large scale, distributed services in the cloud
- Overall system architecture, scalability, reliability, and performance
- Mentoring other engineers, defining our challenging technical culture, and helping to build a fast-growing team

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, AWS Mantle
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building the infrastructure that powers the next generation of AI? We are seeking a Sr. Software Development Engineer to join the AWS Mantle team and drive the technical vision for our distributed inference engine that serves millions of customers across Amazon Bedrock. In this role, you will define and execute on large-scale, ambiguous technical challenges at the intersection of machine learning systems, distributed computing, and security—shaping how the world accesses foundation models.

Set the long-term technical direction for a globally distributed, high-performance ML inference platform serving models from industry-leading AI providers

Own end-to-end system design decisions that directly impact latency, reliability, and scalability for millions of customers worldwide

Influence engineering strategy across Amazon Bedrock, partnering with senior leadership to align technical investments with business outcomes

Raise the engineering bar through exemplary system design, mentorship, and contributions to the broader AWS engineering community

Navigate complex trade-offs across performance, security, and cost while maintaining the highest standards for operational excellence

Key job responsibilities
As a Sr. SDE on the Mantle team, you will serve as the technical conscience and strategic thought leader for one of AWS's most critical AI infrastructure platforms. You will architect solutions that are reliable, scalable, and secure—operating at the cutting edge of distributed systems where millisecond-level latency and zero-trust security are non-negotiable.

Design and evolve the architecture of Mantle's distributed inference engine, including capacity management, model onboarding pipelines, and quality-of-service controls

Drive cross-organizational initiatives spanning multiple AWS teams to deliver seamless, OpenAI-compatible API experiences with Zero Operator Access (ZOA) security guarantees

Lead technical strategy for scaling inference to support rapid onboarding of new foundation models while maintaining global availability and performance SLAs

About the team
The AWS Mantle team is building the next-generation inference engine that powers Amazon Bedrock—providing secure, enterprise-grade access to high-performing foundation models from the world's leading AI companies. Our mission is to simplify and accelerate how models are served at global scale, with an unwavering commitment to customer trust through innovations like our Zero Operator Access architecture, designed so that no person—whether from AWS, a customer, or a model provider—can ever access customer inference data.

We operate at massive scale, serving inference requests across all major AWS regions with sophisticated automated capacity management and unified resource pools

Our team values builders who thrive in ambiguity, think long-term, and are excited to define the future of AI infrastructure from the ground up

We foster a collaborative, inclusive environment where diverse perspectives drive better solutions—and where the best ideas win regardless of where they originate

We ship fast and iterate with purpose, having rapidly expanded from launch to supporting models from OpenAI, DeepSeek, Google, Mistral, NVIDIA, and more

We believe work should be meaningful and fun—you'll join a team that takes pride in making history at the forefront of generative AI

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Data Analytics Integration AI and Platform Excellence

- Design, develop, and implement AI/ML-powered products for data integration workflows which simplifies complexity in data processing.
- Build and own critical infrastructure powering Amazon's next-generation AI capabilities
- Collaborate with data scientists and ML experts to s to transform innovative ideas into production systems
- Optimize existing algorithms and systems for performance, scalability, and reliability
- Contribute to the full software development lifecycle, from conception to production deployment
- Mentor junior engineers and promote best practices in software development and AI implementation

- Growth: Learn from experts while working with the latest in AI technology

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Ads Core Infra (ACI)
jobs.description:
Advertisers will spend tens of billions of dollars this year leveraging Amazon Advertising to grow their business. We are looking for exceptional software engineers to build the next generation of intelligent data services that power AI-driven advertising experiences across the Amazon Advertising portfolio. As part of the advertising organization, our team focuses on delivering real-time data intelligence and advertiser context that enables AI agents and tools to make informed decisions on behalf of advertisers.

This work requires building redundant, highly available systems that scale to serve millions of advertisers across 20+ countries. Our services operate 24/7/365, providing sub-second access to advertiser intelligence that powers campaign recommendations, performance analysis, and automated optimization across all ad programs (Sponsored Ads and DSP).

The ARDS & Profiles team is responsible for two interconnected systems:

Ads AI Realtime Data Service (ARDS) is the analytical intelligence layer for all Amazon Advertising AI agents. We transform terabytes of advertising data (campaigns, ASINs, brands, budgets) into queryable functions that agents call in real-time to answer advertiser questions and drive automated decisions. We are building a near-realtime streaming (sub-1-minute data freshness), scaling from 14 to 20+ query functions, and expanding dataset coverage across Sponsored Ads and DSP programs simultaneously.

Ads Profiles is the personalization substrate for advertiser interactions. We compute and serve structured intelligence documents (advertiser profiles, brand profiles, campaign profiles, user profiles) that give AI agents deep context about who they are serving. This includes LLM-based inference for generating natural-language summaries, a federated contribution framework for partner teams to enrich profiles, and an MCP-based access layer for third-party agent consumption.

Our problem space covers:

Near-realtime data infrastructure: streaming pipelines (Kafka/Kinesis), incremental compaction, manifest-based query engines (DuckDB/Athena), and freshness monitoring with automatic fallback
Multi-tenant authorization: dataset-level permission resolution across multiple account types (Single Global Accounts, Manager Accounts) with configurable bypass mechanisms for internal agent consumers
LLM integration at scale: profile generation for 2.5M+ advertisers with hallucination detection, factual accuracy validation, and cost-optimized inference scheduling
Distributed systems: cross-region DynamoDB replication, regional failover, eventual consistency with strong read guarantees for authorization paths
Performance: P99 < 1 second at 40 TPS sustained for complex analytical queries; P99 < 100ms for profile serving via Fabric SDK
We stand up CI/CD pipelines with automated eval frameworks (300+ parameterized test cases, regression CI gates blocking deployment on correctness drops), integration testing via Hydra, and observability through per-table freshness probes and per-function latency instrumentation. Our engineers ship with confidence knowing that every query function and profile entity type has automated correctness validation before reaching production.

Our team uses AWS services including: DynamoDB, Lambda, ECS/Fargate, EMR (PySpark), Kinesis, S3, Athena, CloudWatch, CDK, CloudFormation, SQS, and Bedrock (Claude) for LLM inference. We build on internal Amazon infrastructure including Coral services, Apollo deployments, the Fabric SDK for agent consumption, and Minos for fine-grained authorization.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and operate real-time data retrieval services that power AI agent decision-making across Amazon Advertising, handling 100M+ API requests per day at sub-5-second latency
- Build and maintain streaming data pipelines that ingest petabyte-scale advertising and retail datasets, transforming raw signals into queryable intelligence functions with sub-10-minute data freshness
- Own the full lifecycle of advertiser profile generation, including LLM-powered entity resolution, knowledge graph construction, and real-time profile serving across 4+ entity types (advertisers, brands, ASINs, categories)
- Design and implement authorization and access control layers that enforce dataset-level permission granularity across multiple account types (Sponsored Ads, DSP, parent accounts) and advertising programs
- Develop evaluation frameworks that measure data quality, query accuracy, and agent decision effectiveness, using automated regression testing to maintain correctness as datasets and functions scale
- Build self-service onboarding infrastructure that allows partner teams (AI agents, campaign management, recommendations) to integrate new datasets and query functions without requiring core team engineering effort
- Operate production services at 99.99%+ availability across 20+ global marketplaces, owning on-call rotations, alarm tuning, runbooks, and incident response for tier-1 advertising infrastructure
- Drive technical design through written documents (design reviews, one-pagers, operational readiness reviews), collaborating with science teams on LLM integration and with data engineering teams on pipeline architecture
- Identify and eliminate scaling bottlenecks through load testing, profiling, and architectural optimization, targeting cost-efficiency improvements in compute, storage, and LLM inference spend
- Mentor engineers on the team through code reviews, design feedback, and architecture discussions, raising the technical bar across the organization

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer, Mobile Robotics
jobs.description:
Amazon Robotics is seeking an Embedded Software Engineer with Rust programming expertise to join our Safety Perception team and help build the safety-rated sensor processing firmware for one of the world's largest autonomous robot fleets. In this role, you will develop embedded firmware on heterogeneous multi-core MCU/CPU/GPU platforms — writing real-time safety applications, sensor processing pipelines, and system interfaces that enable robots operating in Amazon facilities worldwide to detect and respond to obstacles safely and reliably.

We are looking for someone who is proficient in Rust (or strong in C/C++ and eager to work in Rust), is comfortable working across the boundary between RTOS and Linux on the same chip, has experience with sensor data acquisition or signal processing, and can collaborate effectively with cross-functional hardware, functional safety, and navigation teams to deliver firmware that meets the rigor of IEC 61508 functional safety certification.

Key job responsibilities
The ideal candidate is passionate about building the right solutions for our customers and willing to work with other teams to ensure that our product meets Amazon-scale while simultaneously raising the bar for our custsomers' safety. They will:

- Develop and maintain safety-rated and non-safety-rated embedded firmware in Rust on heterogeneous multi-core platforms where real-time safety code and Linux-based services coexist on the same chip.
- Work across the full sensor processing pipeline; from driver integration and frame acquisition, through point cloud generation, to real-time collision detection — ensuring data integrity through black-channel diagnostics.
- Design and implement perception features that enable autonomous robots to detect and respond to obstacles under the constraints of IEC 61508 functional safety certification.
- Contribute to system interfaces and tooling (gRPC/protobuf APIs, CLI tools, visualization) that serve navigation, manufacturing, and field provisioning workflows.
- Produce design documents and safety analysis artifacts that meet the rigor required for third-party certification and witness testing.
- Debug issues end-to-end — from raw sensor data through embedded pipelines to safety system responses — on real robots at test facilities and in production.

A day in the life
No two days are the same. You might spend the morning writing a design document with stakeholders, then head to the test floor after lunch to debug an issue alongside electrical and QA engineers and determine if it is firmware, hardware, or a faulty sensor. That afternoon, you pivot to profiling a processing pipeline on the target platform, making sure it meets its latency budget. In between, you are working closely with teammates to bring it all together. Our engineers take complete ownership, from interrupt handlers to CI/CD pipelines to on-site data collection, and frequently enter new areas to meet our customers' needs.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
The safety perception team is comprised of passionate embedded software engineers who apply innovative advances in robotics and sensor processing to solve real-world safety challenges. We write embedded Rust on platforms where correctness is not optional, and we own the full stack: from low-level driver integration to system APIs to the test infrastructure that proves our firmware works. We take our responsibility for safety seriously but challenge ourselves to produce the right product that also gives us the performance we need. We pay attention to the details so others do not have to, and strive to make systems that are natural and intuitive to use so that safety does not need a second thought.

Do you shop on Amazon? Have you ever browsed a product detail page, scrolled through images, compared prices, checked delivery dates, and then clicked "Add to Cart"? That entire experience? Our team builds it.
The Product & Offers Experience organization is responsible for building the world's best product evaluation and discovery experiences for Amazon shoppers. We own the experiences that help hundreds of millions of customers worldwide make confident purchase decisions, from the moment they land on a product page to the moment they add to cart. Our work spans offer selection, offer display, pricing presentation, and the rich product information that surrounds the buy box. As the worldwide product showroom for the "everything store," we directly drive the majority of purchase decisions on Amazon across all surfaces: mobile, desktop, and voice.
As a Software Development Engineer II on this team, you will own the design and delivery of significant features and services end to end. You will make architectural decisions that shape how hundreds of millions of customers discover, evaluate, and purchase products on Amazon. You will work on highly scalable systems in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where your code ships to customers quickly and your impact is real and measurable. You will raise the operational bar, contribute to a federated architecture that enables hundreds of partner teams across Amazon to innovate, and mentor engineers around you.
The ideal candidate has strong technical depth, sharp problem-solving skills, and a genuine passion for building technology that directly shapes the customer experience. You are customer obsessed, take ownership of your work end to end, and thrive in an environment where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years. If you want to build experiences that matter to hundreds of millions of customers and grow as an engineer alongside a talented, motivated team, we want to meet you.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the design, development, and delivery of major features and services, from broadly defined problems through to production and operations.
- Design and build innovative technologies in a large distributed computing environment and help lead fundamental changes in the industry.
- Make sound architectural and technical trade-offs, and drive engineering best practices, design reviews, code quality, testing, and operational excellence, across the team.
- Build distributed storage, index, and query systems that are scalable, fault-tolerant, low cost, and easy to manage and use.
- Collaborate with cross-disciplinary Amazonians to conceive, design, and bring innovative products and services to market.
- Mentor junior engineers and contribute to the technical growth of the team.

jobs.title: Senior Software Dev Engineer, Enrollment Experience - Benefits Experience & Technology (BXT)
jobs.description:
Enrolling in benefits today means navigating dense plan comparisons, decoding jargon, and hoping you picked the right coverage before a deadline closes. For the agents who support employees, it means toggling between disconnected systems, memorizing policy nuances, and spending 27+ minutes on complex calls that should resolve in under ten. We are changing both by making AI a strategic partner across the entire benefits experience: software that understands what a person needs, personalizes the journey to their life situation, and guides them — or the agent helping them — to a confident resolution at the moment of need. This is a generative-AI, agentic-engineering, and experience-architecture role first, at very large scale.

What you will lead:

A reimagined enrollment experience where AI is a strategic partner for employees making benefit decisions. Rather than walls of plan text, it understands who someone is — family situation, population segment, geography, past elections — and delivers personalized plan recommendations, real cost-per-paycheck impact, and coverage comparisons in plain language. Agentic MCP tools let employees self-serve enrollment actions through natural-language conversation: staging elections, handling qualifying life events, and managing dependent verification, all without navigating a portal.

A reinvented Benefits Management Console (BMC) that transforms how call-center agents support enrollment for a workforce of millions. The next-generation BMC surfaces the employee's full context instantly, displays intelligent adaptive workflows that adjust to case complexity, recommends next-best-actions for edge cases, automates routine verification and notification workflows, and learns from every resolution. The goal: dramatically reduce average call handling time and let agents focus on judgment and empathy rather than system navigation.

You will be the tech lead across both experiences, owning the shared architecture that powers personalized enrollment across all surfaces and the agentic foundations that let AI participate meaningfully in both employee self-service and agent-assisted workflows.

We build AI-native. In our model, humans own judgment and agents own the mechanical middle. Engineers write the specification and set the acceptance criteria; agents (Claude Code, Kiro) write a growing share of the implementation, author tests, and resolve code-review comments; engineers direct, validate, and own what ships, and still hand-write the novel, ambiguous, and infrastructure-heavy work where models fall short.

As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you are the tech lead for your team's product. You lead a system of many features across its full lifecycle — enrollment orchestration (BFF on Apollo GraphQL serving four surfaces), population-aware personalization, agentic tool architectures (MCP-based chatbot tools with consent handling and multi-turn state management), and next-generation agent workflow systems. You own the team-level architecture, make the high-stakes decisions, and review others' work — human-authored and agent-authored alike. You stay hands-on in the code and code reviews that matter most.





Key job responsibilities
• Lead your team's software development end to end: own the team-level architecture for enrollment orchestration, population-aware personalization, and agent console systems. Provide system-wide design guidance across all surfaces (mobile, web, chatbot, agent console) and make the high-stakes, hard-to-reverse technical decisions.

• Be the tech lead on large, ambiguous problems that span multiple organizations — enrollment flow architecture, agentic self-service, agent workflow reinvention, and claims-based plan simulation — where the customer direction is clear but the technology strategy is not. Drive clarity and align partner teams on the path forward.

• Own how AI participates in enrollment: design MCP tool contracts, multi-turn conversation state management, consent and authorization handling, confidence-based escalation, and the boundary between what AI does autonomously and where humans stay in the loop.

• Architect consent-gated, HIPAA-compliant pipelines for claims data ingestion and plan simulation — employee authorization frameworks, PHI handling, and personalized cost projections derived from actual utilization history.

• Architect the next-generation BMC that reduces call handling time: adaptive workflows that surface context and recommended actions, AI-driven automation of routine steps, and displays that adjust to case complexity and agent authorization level.

• Lead the team's AI Native build loops: define the specs, acceptance criteria, and simulation coverage that let agents safely take on more implementation work. Shape the agentic foundations (Bedrock AgentCore, MCP) the team builds on. Stay hands-on in the code and reviews that most affect the product.

• Lead and mentor engineers: coach multiple engineers on and off your team, drive adoption of engineering best practices, and hold human-authored and agent-authored work to the same high bar. Drive operational excellence including alarms, telemetry, runbooks, and root-cause resolution across team boundaries.

• Work backwards from the customer, bringing experience design judgment to technical decisions — partner with UX designers, technical writers, and communications strategists to ensure what gets built is also what gets understood and adopted by employees.



A day in the life
What the day-to-day looks like: you'll operate on a multidisciplinary team of SDEs, UX designers, and technical writers where every member owns real surface area — there are no inherited systems to passively maintain. Open enrollment dates are immovable, so you'll ship under genuine deadline pressure with genuine decision-making authority. You own production end to end, including on-call. You'll partner with UX designers on enrollment flows, collaborate with technical writers on how policy changes reach employees, and work with program managers to sequence delivery across teams. The technical breadth is uncommon: enrollment orchestration across four surfaces, a plan simulation engine ingesting claims data under HIPAA-compliant consent frameworks, population-aware personalization for corporate/WFM/operations employees, agentic chatbot tools for conversational self-service, and an agent console redesign aimed at cutting handle time in half — production agentic systems, regulated data engineering, experience orchestration, and AI-native methods in one seat.

This role is for tech leads who think in systems that serve people at sensitive moments — not just engineers who build features. You'll architect the full spectrum: from consent-gated pipelines that securely process claims data under HIPAA to the personalized recommendation surface that tells an employee "based on your family's actual usage, this plan saves you $1,200 next year." You'll own the boundary between what AI can do autonomously and where a human must stay in the loop. If you want to lead a team that ships production agentic systems, handles regulated health data with rigor, and measures success in reduced decision anxiety for employees and reduced handle time for agents — not just story points closed — this is a rare opportunity to own that end to end.

About the team
You will join Benefits Experience Technology (BXT), the Amazon organization reinventing how more than 1.5 million employees and their families experience benefits enrollment — and how the specialists who support them operate. Our vision is enrollment that is AI-powered, personalized, and proactive, and an agent console that is intelligent, workflow-driven, and fast.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, Customer Experience Infrastructure (CXI)
jobs.description:
If you’re excited about solving deep technical challenges and building innovative software that directly influences how Amazon Now Dark Stores and fulfillment centers are designed and launched from the ground up, this could be a the role for you. You’ll join a team being built from scratch in Bengaluru—offering a rare opportunity to be an early member and help shape how we operate, innovate, and scale.

The Team
Within Amazon Robotics’ Operations Infrastructure Services (OIS) organization, the Customer Experience Infrastructure (CXI) team delivers region-specific, customer-centric solutions focused on cost optimization, operational transparency, process simplification, and lifecycle management. Our mission is to reduce the cost and time required to build and operate the Tech infra in Amazon fulfillment centers, Whole Foods stores, and quick commerce stores.

The Role
Everyone on our team needs to be entrepreneurial, wear many hats and work in a highly collaborative environment that’s more startup than big company. We’re solving problems that will help you develop expertise across multiple domains including: Amazon dark store and fulfillment center supply chain systems, Warehouse management solution, Network infra, End-user equipment, Machine Learning, and Distributed Systems. Your primary focus will be designing and building software services that dramatically reduce the cost and time required to launch Amazon fulfillment centers, Whole Foods and quick commerce stores.

Key job responsibilities
As an SDE, you are responsible for setting a high bar throughout the software development and deployment lifecycle, including design, development, documentation, testing, and operations.
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software development(both backend and frontend) in Java, Python, react, AWS technologies. He/she will work closely with the business and technical teams to analyze many non-standard and unique business problems and use creative problem solving to build quick Proofs of concept and deliver production grade software.
He/she will be a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, able to think big and be creative while paying careful attention to detail and will enjoy working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.


A day in the life
Our team follows the Agile development methodology. Team members(SDEs/PMT/TPM) participate in daily stand-ups and bi-weekly sprint planning and backlog grooming sessions. You will write code for both user-facing APIs and backend services that need to be fault-tolerant and low-latency. You will participate in design reviews, contribute to technical discussions, and collaborate with other teams within Customer Experience Infra Org on integration solutions. We conduct annual program planning and quarterly prioritization meetings to align tasks with organizational goals. Developers, Program Management (PM) team, and Single-Threaded Owners (STOs) collaborate to define and execute these tasks. Since it’s a new team, we do not have any operational load at present, but in future we will operational maintain what we deliver this year.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, Account Compliance Tech
jobs.description:
We are the guardians of the Amazon galaxy. The Account Compliance team strives to ensure that Amazon remains compliant and the cost of being compliant is never the reason where the business or our sellers cannot scale. Our diverse team innovates on behalf of their customers to build a trusted marketplace through best-in-class compliance products. With hundreds of millions of customers around the world depending on our products & services, our systems form the tip of the spear against bad actors. These actors might abuse Amazon products and undermine customer faith, so our success comes from identifying & removing them while delivering best-in-class customer experiences for the good actors and strategic customers. We’re creating the most trusted store on earth, enabling Amazon to innovate at scale, and supporting our customers to launch & grow their business faster than anywhere else in the world.
As a Software Development Engineer in the account compliance team, you will design and build software that 1) is extensible to different use cases, products, and geographies with almost zero incremental tech effort, 2) can trigger verifications that are necessary under applicable policies, 3) can store verification decisions for re-use to reduce duplicative checks; and (5) is vendible to any authorized user via API. The software is smarter than the smartest bad actors in the world to protect the store from illegal activities at scale. Amazon's scale means that you'll be designing and developing custom distributed systems more advanced than those used in standard industry practices. These data-centric systems need to detect patterns across Amazon's huge customer population as they happen and be adaptive so that they can detect new modus operandi as they develop. Lastly, they need to be highly available, low latency, high quality systems. If this sounds interesting to you, then apply and find out more!

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer, Leo Autopilot
jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon Leo will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.


Export Control Requirement
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
* Work with our peer teams and customers to design suitable software systems to fulfill the mission needs.
* Develop cloud native software systems in Java and Python.
* Utilize AWS and other Amazon technologies to build highly-available software services.
* Design and develop performant software systems that meet the mission criteria and requirements.
* Help on-board and mentor new team members.
* Lead technical roadmap definition efforts and decide which features and performance improvements to build.

A day in the life
As a Software Development Engineer, you will play a crucial role in the development of services to support the automation of the Leo mission. You will work with a dynamic group of passionate engineers and collaborators across peer teams to identify automation needs, design novel solutions that meet customer requirements, and write software to automate key behaviors for our constellation's space and ground assets. You will be building low-latency, highly-scalable architecture to generate and execute our mission plans safely and effectively.

About the team
The Autopilot team builds software which supports the automated planning and execution of satellite activities, empowering humans to automate key tasks and take themselves out of the loop as we scale the Leo constellation. We own services that model spacecraft behaviors, predict future vehicle state, capture operational constraints on our system, and generate mission schedules that serve our customers while preserving vehicle health and safety.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Ads Campaign Management
jobs.description:
Amazon Advertising is one of Amazon's fastest growing and most profitable businesses, responsible for defining and delivering AI-powered solutions that transform how advertisers make strategic decisions. We deliver billions of ad impressions and process massive volumes of advertiser data every single day. You'll work with us to pioneer breakthrough approaches in how AI agents access and reason over real-time advertiser data at scale.

The Campaign Management team is responsible for capturing inputs for advertisers to control their advertising efforts. You can think of our team as the brain and nervous system of all the advertisements you see on amazon.com. We build large scale, high velocity distributed systems to service 100’s of millions of API requests per day, steam data at PB scale, process business logic on tight latency budgets, all while streaming and the data at high fidelity to 20+ other services to perform other critical advertising functions. We stand up world class CI/CD pipelines to deploy our service automating infrastructure provisioning, high volume load testing and first-rate monitoring so our engineers can keep their heads down inventing for our advertisers. Our problem space covers concurrent workflows across distributed systems (linearizability, eventual consistency), big data problems (propagation delay, ordering and hygiene) and performance (search optimization). Our team uses the latest AWS products and services to solve our problems including but not limited to: ECS, Fargate, EC2, EMR, Lambda, Kafka, Elastic Search, Dynamo DB, SQS, SNS, Cloud watch, CDK, Cloud Formation and many more.

We are using generative AI and agentic systems to help advertising agents provide instant, strategic advice to millions of advertisers. You will need to invent new techniques for global ads experience, agent orchestration, and context optimization to ensure we're delivering accurate, trustworthy insights with minimal latency and token consumption. You'll create feedback loops to ensure our solutions are constantly evaluating themselves and improving.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement scalable architectures for APIs serving millions of advertisers at thousands of transactions per second
- Build Model Context Protocol (MCP) server infrastructure—an emerging standard for AI agent-data interaction—that delivers advertiser context with sub-second latency and minimal token consumption
- Establish system design patterns and best practices for global ads experience at scale

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to join the ENA Express team. You will design, build, and own features across the full ENA Express software stack: Firmware on the Nitro-Card, user-space libraries, control plane components, and the performance analytics systems that help our customers get the most out of their network. This is high-ownership work — your code runs on a fleet of millions of EC2 instances, supporting customers who demand the absolute best from their network, including HPC clusters, large-scale ML training, financial services, and other latency-critical applications.


Key job responsibilities
• Design and develop features across the AWS Networking software stack on Nitro Cards.
• Deep-dive into ENA Express and the underlying SRD protocol and L3/L4 networking to optimize packet delivery, reduce tail latency, and improve bandwidth utilization.
• Collaborate with hardware and firmware partners to define software/hardware interfaces and surface programmable capabilities to the software layer
• Partner with EC2 platform and service teams to integrate ENA Express features into the broader AWS networking ecosystem
• Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, lead design reviews, and champion engineering best practices across the team
• Drive operational excellence: build observability, contribute to on-call health, and lead incident response and post-mortems


About the team
We are a team of senior engineers with deep expertise in systems software, networking protocols, and EC2 infrastructure. Our work spans the full stack — from the Firmware on the driver Card, and NIC driver layer up through the EC2 control plane — and we collaborate closely with hardware, firmware, and platform partners. jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, AWS Infra Supply Chain Automation
jobs.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Do you enjoy building systems from the ground up? Are you passionate about setting standards for an AWS product in its early stages of development, as well as influence its architecture and product ideation? jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Leo Flight Software Team
jobs.description:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

About the Role:

We are looking for an Embedded Software Development Engineer to build and scale - VirtSat (Leo's Virtual Satellite Simulation platform). VirtSat enables developers and pipelines across Leo to create, provision, and test virtual satellites, ground gateways, customer terminals, and TT&C antennas on EC2 bare-metal infrastructure running KVM/QEMU.

As part of role, you will own the Graviton virtualization layer, managing VM lifecycle, LRU boot, subsystem provisioning, and software deployment for every virtual entity in the constellation. You will work at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, embedded Linux, and satellite operations building the platform that every Leo satellite software release is tested on before launch.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
What You'll Work On :

* Own the Graviton bare-metal virtualization layer — KVM/QEMU VM management, subsystem start/stop, health monitoring, and fault recovery.
* Develop embedded software in Rust, C, C++, or other modern languages for the virtualization and emulation layer
* Write device drivers and system applications for the various satellite systems running on virtual hardware
* Write software to interact with micro-controllers and emulated hardware peripherals (FPGA, HSM, sensors)
* Build and maintain the custom AMI pipeline that pre-configures all satellite dependencies, reducing provisioning time and preventing dependency drift
* Develop and optimize provisioning scripts that deploy satellite software (LEP images, firmware, certificates) onto emulated LRUs via SSM
* Implement plugin framework extensions for new LRU types (satellites, GGMAs, GTMAs, customer terminals) on the Graviton host
* Build network virtualization between VMs — WireGuard tunnels, inter-entity networking, and TT&C link emulation
* Optimize boot-time and provisioning latency for QEMU-based satellite instances
* Debug and resolve issues at the intersection of host OS (Ubuntu/ARM64), guest OS (LEP/Yocto), and QEMU emulation
* Develop fidelity improvements — HSM crypto emulation, EFUSE emulation, CAN bus simulation, and error injection frameworks
* Work closely with other software and hardware teams to support board bring-up and integration testing

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Data Center Builder Tools
jobs.description:
The Data Center Builder Tools team is looking for a seasoned, self-directed Senior Software Development Engineer to lead the design and evolution of the real-time middleware and controls platform that powers industrial control systems across AWS Data Centers worldwide. Contribute to Amazon's vision of developing the safest, most secure, reliable, and efficient data centers on Earth.

As a Senior Software Development Engineer (SDE III) on this team, you will set the technical direction for the software that sits between industrial hardware and the cloud, a unified, real-time data plane that lets control applications, device drivers, and cloud services exchange data reliably on industrial computing hardware. This is deep systems work at the boundary of software and hardware: you will own the architecture of the controls, the communication layer, and the protocol and cloud integrations that the entire platform is built on, and you will be the engineer others turn to for the hardest problems in real-time, distributed, and embedded systems.

In this role you will

Own the architecture: of the real-time middleware and controls, the data-exchange layer, canonical type system, and communication patterns (publish/subscribe and request/reply) that connect distributed control applications across languages and hardware and drive it through multiple iterations as requirements scale.

Set technical strategy: for how the platform integrates with industrial automation platforms and hardware protocols (e.g. IEC 61131-3, EtherCAT, PROFINET, Modbus, OPC-UA, IO-Link) and how new device drivers are built, so the platform scales to many protocols without bespoke effort.

Define the edge-to-cloud contract: how telemetry, metrics, and commands flow between devices and AWS services, with the right delivery guarantees, quality-of-service, and failure semantics for each class of data.

Solve the defining hard problems: of a system where correctness means both the right result and the right timing, bounded latency, determinism, resource constraints on embedded hardware, and graceful degradation when connectivity is lost.

Multiply the team: establish engineering standards, mentor SDE I/IIs and raise the bar in hiring, reviews, and design, and align hardware, controls, security, and operations partners around a shared technical vision.

If you're excited by low-level systems, real-time data movement, and connecting physical equipment to the cloud at scale and by being the technical leader who makes it happen this is the role for you.




Key job responsibilities
As an SDE III on this team, you are a technical leader accountable for the architecture and long-term health of the controls and middleware platform, not just individual components. You will operate across multiple workstreams and teams, make the consequential design decisions, and remain deeply hands-on where it matters most.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

Architecting the platform, not just components: owning the end-to-end design of the controls and real-time middleware across embedded/edge controllers and the cloud, making the durable decisions on type systems, serialization, memory layout, schema evolution, and communication patterns that everything else depends on.

Driving multi-quarter technical strategy: defining the roadmap for the next iteration of "What comes next", industrial protocol support, and cloud integration, sequencing the work, and making explicit build-vs-buy and short-term-vs-durable tradeoffs with the data to back them.

Owning real-time correctness at system scale: reasoning about latency budgets, throughput, determinism, and failure modes across a distributed system adjacent to physical control loops, and setting the standards that keep those guarantees intact as the system grows.

Leading cross-team and cross-discipline efforts: turning ambiguous, org-level requirements into clear technical direction, and aligning hardware, controls, security, and operations partners (and other software teams) around shared interfaces and contracts.

Raising the engineering bar broadly: establishing standards for testing (unit, integration, and on-hardware validation), performance benchmarking, operational excellence, and code quality, and holding the team to them through design and code review.

Growing engineers: mentoring Junior and Mid level SDE, developing their technical judgment, and contributing as a strong interviewer and bar raiser in hiring.

De-risking the hardest problems: personally diving into the highest-ambiguity, highest-impact technical challenges (new protocol integrations, performance-critical paths, cross-language data exchange) and bringing them to a proven, maintainable end state.

The ideal candidate is a senior systems engineer with a track record of owning the architecture of complex software systems and delivering them to production. You have depth across several of: real-time or embedded systems, industrial automation platforms and hardware protocols, distributed systems, middleware/messaging (pub/sub, RPC), and cloud communication and the breadth to reason about how all of these fit together into a coherent platform. You are comfortable working close to the metal (memory, concurrency, serialization, timing) and setting direction at the system and organizational level. You influence beyond your own team, make sound decisions under ambiguity and hardware/timing constraints, and lift the engineers around you. Experience with Rust, C/C++, or Python, and with technologies such as industrial automation platforms, OPC-UA, DDS/Zenoh or similar real-time middleware, is a strong advantage.

A day in the life
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

About the team
The Data Center Builder Tools team develops tooling for device frameworks, and device lifecycle management in AWS Data Centers. This includes both frontend and backend services use by internal development teams and on-site customers. Our tools power the industrial controls systems deployed in our data centers.

Diverse Experiences

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Manager, Mobile Robotics
jobs.description:
Amazon Robotics is seeking a Software Development Manager to lead an embedded software team building the safety-rated sensor processing firmware that lets one of the world's largest autonomous robot fleets operate safely alongside people. You will lead a team of embedded software engineers who own real-time safety applications, sensor processing pipelines, and system interfaces on heterogeneous multi-core MCU/CPU/GPU platforms: the firmware that enables robots in Amazon facilities worldwide to detect and respond to obstacles reliably. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will set technical direction, grow and develop the team, and own delivery of firmware that meets the rigor of IEC 61508 functional safety certification.

We are looking for a manager who pairs people leadership with strong technical depth in embedded or safety-critical systems. This is a highly technical role, not a purely people-management one: you should be able to dive deep in design and safety-analysis discussions, review architecture and code with authority, make sound architectural trade-offs, and earn the technical trust of a team that writes code where correctness is not optional. You will coach engineers, hold a high bar on design and code quality, and partner effectively across electrical, mechanical, functional safety, navigation, and manufacturing teams.

Key job responsibilities
The ideal candidate is passionate about building the right solutions for our customers, developing great engineers, and raising the bar for associate safety at Amazon scale. As the manager of this team, you will:

- Hire, coach, and develop a high-judgment, bar-raising team of embedded software engineers.
- Own the technical roadmap, delivery, and operational excellence for your team's portfolio of safety-rated firmware.
- Set and uphold engineering standards across the sensor processing pipeline: from driver integration through point cloud generation to real-time collision detection.
- Partner with electrical, mechanical, functional safety, navigation, and manufacturing teams to close failure modes identified in failure mode analyses.
- Represent the team in safety certification, design reviews, and third-party witness testing, ensuring artifacts meet the rigor required for IEC 61508.
- Make transparent trade-offs between long-term architecture and near-term delivery, balancing safety, performance, and schedule.

A day in the life
No two days are the same. You might start in 1:1s and a design review, helping an engineer think through a black-channel diagnostic or a latency budget. Before lunch you negotiate scope for the next certification milestone with functional safety and navigation. In the afternoon you head to the test floor alongside your engineers and the electrical and QA teams: is it firmware, hardware, or a faulty sensor? In between, you unblock the team, give feedback on a design, and think ahead about hiring and architecture. Our managers own it all, from their engineers' growth to what ships to production robots.

About the team
The AR Firmware organization is the world-leading embedded software team behind many of the robotic systems Amazon Robotics deploys: fleets of over 1M drive units and safety-critical products that let associates work alongside robots safely. Within it, the Safety Perception team owns the safety-critical firmware in Proteus, Amazon's first robot that can safely share a work area with people. We specialize in the bandwidth and complexity of depth cameras, LiDARs, iTOFs, and dTOFs, and in proving under certification that those sensors meet requirements across all operating conditions. We keep safety software lean, prioritize test infrastructure early, and sweat the details so others do not have to.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer III, AWS Core Networking – Network Fabric Engineering, Core Networking - Edge Capacity
jobs.description:
Do you like to use network and Unix systems engineering to deliver simple, sustainable, and repeatable solutions? Would you like to play a key role in driving the stability and sustainability of next-generation IP networks?

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Core Networking team is looking for a Software Development Engineer to join our Network Fabric Engineering (NFE) team. As a Software Development Engineer, you will be responsible for building software services to deploy and scale the Amazon networks that support AWS, customers, and other business units, across multiple global datacenters.

AWS Core Networking is focused on building Data Centers and the network that allows Data Centers to function efficiently. We own the solutions that allow racks to be aggregated and Data Centers to be interconnected. Core Networking's goal is to balance efficiency, performance and reliability to allow customers access to their applications and data.



Key job responsibilities
We are looking for an experienced Software Development Engineer with production quality software services experience. You are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where delivery of new services and features is very rapid. The ideal candidate will demonstrate established software engineering expertise, having successfully developed and launched extensive distributed systems in collaboration with a team. You are adaptable, capable of excelling in a dynamic and entrepreneurial setting. You will be responsible for delivering high quality, extensible design and code. You are expected to have extensive background in network engineering and can troubleshoot network issues. You are expected to mentor and guide junior engineers. You are comfortable managing competing priorities and are able to bring order to ambiguous scenarios. You identify and implement optimizations for performance, scalability, and efficiency. Maturity, impeccable judgment, and the ability to influence and lead are essential to success in this role. You are data-driven and analytical. You have the ability to communicate clearly and effectively, both in writing and verbally, across organizations.

A day in the life
• Work in a 24x7 team on call rotation, with ability to drive into workplace for critical events/needs.
• Manage customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure.
• Sit at the computer during scheduled work hours with appropriate breaks while maintaining a high level of alertness and attention to detail.
• Travel to data center/network sites and Amazon/customer offices as needed.
About the team


About the team
AWS NFE (Network Fabric Engineering) owns datacenter network services that provide unconstrained connectivity to our customers, such as EC2, EBS, S3 and Amazon CDO Services. They own the networks internal to the datacenters end to end, including scaling and operational functions, for both traditional datacenters. They also own newer AWS offerings such as Outposts and Local Zones.
Working at AWS in the Core Networking Team

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Customer Service AI powered Content Solutions
jobs.description:
We are seeking a talented leader with strong technical background to join our Customer Experience Products organization on the CS (Amazon Customer Service) Content Solutions team. In this pivotal role, you will be reimagining how we create and manage content in a Native AI-world, distilling long-form CS help articles, policies, and standard operating procedures to their core underlying policy facts ('Knowledge Artifacts'). You will have the opportunity to influence a large group of product owners, software engineers, machine learning experts, and data scientists globally as we build the foundation that AI powers customer service experiences across Amazon. This role will give you the chance to tackle challenges that influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world across diverse set of marketplaces, languages and locales


Key job responsibilities
- Lead the design, implementation, and successful delivery of large-scale software efforts involving significant work on the CS Knowledge platform, working backwards from customer needs to define vision and architecture.
- Architect and develop robust, scalable services that handle millions of concurrent users and billions of requests
- Champion software development best practices by implementing both traditional methodologies and AI-enhanced tools for code standards, testing, and debugging
- Partner with diverse stakeholders to understand requirements, priorities, and processes, serving as the primary point of contact for project deliverables across teams.
- Propose and implement new projects and system improvements, setting clear, measurable quality goals for your organization in a data-driven way that improves performance and cost efficiency.

A day in the life
As a Software Development Engineer, you'll be a technical leader helping drive decisions that impact critical customer experiences. You'll tackle complex technical initiatives head-on, building high-quality, scalable systems that serve our global customer base. Working closely with principal engineers, you'll help shape our technical architecture while maintaining direct ownership of key components.

About the team
This role sits within the Customer Experience Products organization on the CS Knowledge team. Our vision is a world where customer and associate-facing CS content is always relevant, accurate, complete, and fresh, and is served-up effectively across all channels. We're shifting the paradigm for content creation and maintenance, moving from an output-driven approach based on static content types to a trusted set of artifacts about Amazon products, services, and policies that generate accurate, consistent, and personalized content in any form. Join our team to help build the foundation that powers customer service experiences across Amazon.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Config, AWS Config
jobs.description:
Are you a software development engineer who wants to build the systems that hundreds of thousands of AWS customers rely on to keep their cloud environments secure and compliant? The AWS Config Rules Platform team is looking for
an SDE to work on the core evaluation engine that continuously assesses millions of resources across thousands of accounts — powering compliance at scale for enterprises worldwide.

AWS Config Rules is how customers enforce security policies, detect misconfigurations, and maintain compliance with frameworks like PCI-DSS, HIPAA, and FedRAMP — both reactively and proactively, across entire AWS Organizations.
You'll own critical infrastructure end-to-end: designing, building, and operating distributed systems that evaluate resource configurations at massive scale across every AWS Region.

- Work on one of the largest configuration compliance platforms in the world
- Full breadth of work: scaling the evaluation engine, building new customer-facing capabilities, and driving operational excellence
- Tenured team with strong engineers, a dedicated PE, and a collaborative leadership structure
- Low operational noise — most of your time is spent building, not firefighting
- High autonomy with real ownership over what you ship and how you operate it

Key job responsibilities

- Design, build, and operate high-scale, highly available distributed services that power the AWS Config Rules evaluation engine
- Own solutions across the full lifecycle: design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, and support
- Improve platform scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency as customer adoption and evaluation volume grow
- Build new capabilities that expand how customers evaluate, enforce, and remediate compliance across their AWS resources
- Participate in on-call rotation, drive root cause analysis, and continuously improve operational health
- Collaborate with partner teams across Config, Resource Explorer, Security Hub, and the broader AWS governance ecosystem
- Contribute to a strong engineering culture through rigorous code reviews, design discussions, and technical mentorship of peers

A day in the life
As an SDE on the Config Rules Platform team, you'll spend your time designing and building the distributed systems that evaluate customer compliance at scale. On any given day, you might be writing a design document for a new
evaluation capability, diving deep into performance bottlenecks in the evaluation pipeline, or reviewing code with teammates. You'll work closely with tenured engineers and a dedicated Principal Engineer who supports the
platform directly.

Your customers are both external — the hundreds of thousands of AWS accounts running Config Rules to enforce security and compliance policies — and internal, as other AWS services like Security Hub and Conformance Packs depend
on the evaluation infrastructure you build and operate. When something needs attention operationally, you'll investigate, fix forward, and drive the root cause so the team doesn't see the same issue twice.

The team operates with high autonomy. You'll own your projects end-to-end, collaborate across team boundaries when work touches adjacent services like Resource Explorer or Weirwood, and have the space to propose and drive
improvements to how the platform works and how the team operates.

About the team
The Config Rules Platform team owns the core evaluation infrastructure that underpins AWS Config Rules — a service used by enterprise customers managing millions of resources across thousands of accounts and multiple regions. We
build the systems that enable customers to continuously assess compliance, detect drift, and enforce security policy across their entire AWS environment.

Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren't focused on how many hours you spend at
work or online. Instead, we're happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well-balanced life—both in and outside of work.
