Our custom chips, accelerators, and software stacks enable us to take on technical challenges that have never been seen before, and deliver results that help our customers change the world.

AWS Neuron is the complete software stack for the AWS Trainium and Inferentia cloud-scale machine
learning accelerators and the Trn3/Trn2/Trn1 and Inf2/Inf1 servers that use them. This role is for a software engineer in the Distributed Training team for AWS Neuron. This role is responsible for development, enablement and performance tuning of a wide variety of ML model families, including massive scale multi-modal large language models like Llama, Qwen, gpt-oss, DeepSeek and beyond, as well as multi-modal generation models such as Stable Diffusion, Flux, WAN, and many more.

The Distributed Training team works side by side with chip architects, compiler engineers and runtime engineers to create, build and tune distributed training solutions with AWS Trainium, maximize training throughput, minimize time-to-convergence, and push the boundaries of training efficiency on Trainium. You will identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across the stack, from collective communications and memory utilization to compiler optimizations and kernel performance.

Key job responsibilities
This role will lead efforts to optimize distributed training performance on Trainium, with a primary focus on maximizing training throughput, model flops utilization, and efficiency across the Neuron software stack. You will work across PyTorch, JAX, and the Neuron compiler and runtime to enable and tune large-scale training workloads on the latest Trainium instances.

About the team
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.

jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer - AWS Glacier, Cold Storage, Glacier Customer Experience
jobs.description:
The vast majority of data in the world is cold -- it must be durably and securely retained for long periods of time, but is rarely ever accessed. Conventional storage systems are a poor fit for this domain as they are typically optimized for speed rather than space and cost. Amazon Glacier, Amazon Web Service’s recently launched storage service, has been designed from the ground up to provide extremely secure, durable and scalable cold data storage at an extremely low cost. This unique set of constraints leads us to fascinating scaling and algorithmic problems that have never been tacked at our scale. In order to meet our vigorous cost goals, we have a constant need to drive fundamentally new storage technologies in the industry and come up with innovative ways to further optimize costs. We are beginning to work on the next set of major architectural enhancements to the service and are searching for a great senior engineer to join our growing team and our rapidly growing service.


As a developer on our team, you'll have the opportunity to lead the design and implementation of a distributed storage service that operates at scale. Your design and development work would range from distributed system service development in Java, to low level systems coding that interfaces directly with hardware. You'll operate on the bleeding edge of innovations in the storage field, and will need to solve challenging fundamental computer science problems.


We are looking for a senior engineer who is keen to lead, invent in this space, and build what could easily become the largest data storage service on the planet.


Key job responsibilities
- Collaborate with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to conceive, design, and bring innovative products and services to market.
- Design and build innovative technologies in a large distributed computing environment and help lead fundamental changes in the industry.
- Work with other team members to investigate design approaches, prototype new technology and evaluate technical feasibility.
- Take feature specifications and deliver working code that is maintainable and extendable.
- Build distributed storage, index, and query systems that are scalable, fault-tolerant, low cost, and easy to manage/use.
- Design and code the right solutions starting with broadly defined problems.
- Work in an agile environment to deliver high-quality software.




About the team

ABOUT AWS:
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

jobs.title: Chief Auditor
jobs.description: About MoonPay MoonPay is for builders with something to prove. This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. 30M+ customers and 500+ ecosystem partners run on us. Licensed in the U.S. Regulated across the UK, EU, Canada, and Australia. AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters. You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together. The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building for what's next, for humans and agents. Recent recognition: Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 . 2nd in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100, The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running. Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot. ______________________________________________________________________________________________________ About The Opportunity The Chief Auditor will serve as MoonPay's internal audit executive, responsible for designing, building, and leading an independent, risk-based audit function across MoonPay. This is a rare opportunity to build a best-in-class audit capability from the ground up within a crypto-native company at the intersection of traditional finance, digital asset infrastructure, and global regulatory complexity. The Chief Auditor will provide the MoonPay Board and senior leadership with independent assurance that MoonPay's risk management, control environment, and governance frameworks are operating effectively across a multi-entity global footprint.

jobs.description: About MoonPay MoonPay is for builders with something to prove. This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot. ______________________________________________________________________________________________________ About the Opportunity MoonPay is strengthening its control environment as part of its long-term strategy to build a robust, scalable, and compliant platform at the intersection of financial services and digital assets. We are hiring a Chief Control Officer to build and lead a strong first-line risk and control framework across relevant areas of our business. This is an opportunity for an experienced financial services controls leader to build and scale a control environment in a fast-evolving industry. You will be responsible for ensuring that risks are effectively identified, appropriate controls are designed and implemented, and their effectiveness is continuously monitored as MoonPay grows. The role will have a particular focus on fiduciary, custody, and regulated financial services activities, requiring significant experience operating within the US banking environment and a strong working knowledge of applicable regulatory and supervisory expectations. You will work closely with business leaders and with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Internal Audit, and other control functions to establish clear accountability, strengthen first-line ownership, and build a control environment capable of supporting an increasingly complex financial services business. What You Will Do Build and own the first-line risk and control framework across relevant MoonPay activities, including risk and control assessments, control standards, documentation, governance, issue management, and ongoing monitoring of control effectiveness. Embed effective controls into business processes, translating regulatory requirements, policies, identified risks, and supervisory expectations into practical and sustainable controls with clear ownership and accountability. Establish a robust control monitoring and testing program, identifying control weaknesses, assessing their impact, driving remediation, and providing clear reporting on the effectiveness of the control environment. Develop the control framework supporting fiduciary, custody, and other regulated financial services activities, ensuring appropriate governance, processes, controls, and monitoring are embedded throughout the relevant business activities. Partner effectively across the three lines of defence, working with business leaders and independent Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Internal Audit teams to establish clear roles, effective challenge, timely remediation, and strong first-line ownership. Build for scale and increasing complexity, establishing the procedures, governance, reporting, systems, and operating cadence required to maintain a robust control environment as MoonPay evolves. About You You bring 15+ years of relevant experience within US banking or regulated financial services, including significant leadership experience in first-line risk, business controls, operational risk, or a comparable control function. You have a proven track record as a builder and operator, with hands-on experience designing, implementing, and improving first-line control frameworks spanning risk assessments, control design, monitoring and testing, issue management, remediation, and governance. You have deep working knowledge of US banking regulation and supervisory expectations, with meaningful experience supporting fiduciary, trust, custody, transaction services, or closely related banking activities. You have a strong understanding of the three lines of defence model and experience establishing effective first-line ownership while partnering closely with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Internal Audit, and senior business stakeholders. You are comfortable operating in a high-ambiguity, fast-scaling environment, combining strong technical judgement with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and personally drive the development of robust control infrastructure from the ground up. Salary: 330,000 - 400,000 USD Salary is based on experience and location in the US

Advise on and draft terms of service, user disclosures, and consumer protection documentation for DeFi-facing product features. Develop scalable legal review frameworks and playbooks that enable the product and compliance teams to self-serve on routine product questions. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, KYB - MoonPay Enterprise
jobs.description: MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove. This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes. AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters. You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together. The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100, made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running. About MoonPay Enterprise MoonPay Enterprise is one of the more operationally complex products in the stablecoin space: multiple banking providers, multiple payment rails, a growing partner base across two product lines (Orchestration and Issuance), and an active compliance surface across each. MoonPay Enterprise runs B2B, B2B2B, and B2B2C models. Partners integrate our API. Their customers become direct customers of MoonPay Enterprise for compliance purposes. KYB is the front door. Every partner is a business. Every business customer of every partner clears KYB before a single transaction moves. Today the flow is part automated registry verification, part manual review, with different rules for the US and the rest of the world, and turnaround measured in days. That does not scale to where MoonPay Enterprise is going. KYB has to become a product: measurable, fast, API-first, defensible in front of regulators and banking partners. This is a principal seat. You set the multi-year direction for how businesses enter MoonPay Enterprise, and you own the outcome. What You'll Own KYB product strategy & roadmap Business onboarding end-to-end, across every model MoonPay Enterprise runs: partners onboarding onto MoonPay Enterprise, businesses onboarding directly, and business customers onboarding through partners. Platform altitude. KYB decisions ripple into KYC, Travel Rule capture, banking-provider onboarding, and Issuance partner diligence. Connect the surfaces; don't optimise one in isolation. MoonPay Enterprise runs three KYC delivery models (reliance, outsourcing, hosted). KYB coverage is uneven across them. You decide where it expands and in what order. Genuine product depth on MoonPay Enterprise is non-negotiable. Within weeks you talk fluently about KYB outcomes, UBO requirements, virtual account structures, and API behaviour. From being hands-on, not from documentation. Onboarding funnel & conversion The KYB funnel is yours: pass rate, time-to-verified against a 48-72h target, manual review rate, drop-off per step. Instrument what isn't instrumented. Make approval speed and rejection quality measurable. Then move both. Fix rejection UX. Today a declined business often gets a status without a reason, and the partner escalates to support to find out what is missing. Rejection reasons, retry semantics, and resubmission flows become API surface partners build on. KYB API & partner experience The KYB API surface: statuses, webhooks, document submission, and the edge cases that make business onboarding hard (sole proprietors, corporate shareholders, one person who is UBO, Director, and Representative at once). Partners integrate KYB in weeks and self-serve their onboarding questions. Every "what is missing for this customer" escalation is a product gap. Close it. Compliance as product Turn compliance-approved onboarding matrices into product logic. US and non-US differ: control prong versus directors, when ownership documents are required, self-certification options. Partners should never need to read a matrix. EDD triggers, high-risk classification, prohibited industries, Travel Rule capture: you decide how they show up in the product. Compliance is your sparring partner, not a ticket queue. You shape how policy becomes product. They own the policy. Vendor & provider orchestration The verification stack (SumSub today) and the build-versus-buy calls around it. Cost per verification, automation rate, vendor performance. Know when a second provider, a waterfall, or in-house tooling earns its place. Push automation. Decide where AI-assisted review with a human in the loop replaces manual queues, and prove it does not raise risk. Every new banking provider brings its own onboarding requirements. Keep KYB compatible with every rail without collecting everything from everyone. Who You Are A principal-level PM with real KYB or KYC depth. You have owned onboarding, identity, verification, or risk as a platform, not a feature. High agency. You do not wait for a mandate, a brief, or perfect data. You find the problem, claim it, and fix it. Full autonomy, zero to one. Hand you an unowned surface and you take it from first principles to shipped. No handover document, no waiting for direction. AI-fluent by default. AI tools are your daily instruments for analysis, prototyping, and drafting. You run your own queries; analysis is not something you request from another team. Compliance is a design constraint, not a blocker. You read a requirements matrix and see API design, funnel steps, and copy. You know your funnel cold: pass rate, time-to-verified, manual review rate, cost per verification. At home in API-first B2B. Your users are partner engineers and the businesses behind them, not consumers. You have run verification vendors (SumSub, Persona, or equivalents) and know when to switch, stack, or build. A multiplier for the product team around you. You raise the bar for how compliance-heavy product work gets scoped, specced, and shipped. Bias to action. Reactive stewardship of an existing flow is not what we are hiring for. NYC Salary: $217,000 - $279,000

It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. 30M+ customers and 500+ ecosystem partners run on us. Licensed in the U.S. Regulated across the UK, EU, Canada, and Australia. AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters. You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together. The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building for what's next, for humans and agents. Recent recognition: Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 . 2nd in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100, The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running. Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot. ______________________________________________________________________________________________________ 1. About the Opportunity ✍️ We are looking for a Strategy & Biz Ops Lead to work closely with our SVP, Strategy and Investments Development and help drive some of MoonPay’s highest-priority strategic initiatives. This is a high-impact, highly cross-functional role at the intersection of strategy, business operations, and corporate development. You will act as a force multiplier for the SVP, helping translate strategic priorities into clear plans, driving complex initiatives forward, and ensuring alignment and accountability across teams. You’ll work across a broad range of topics, from supporting strategic transactions and partnerships to improving operating cadence and tackling high-priority projects that don’t sit neatly within a single team. The ideal candidate combines strong strategic judgment with an operator mindset: someone who can move seamlessly from structuring an ambiguous problem to getting into the details required to deliver an outcome. 2. What you will do Partner closely with the SVP of Strategy & Investments to translate strategic priorities into clear plans, workstreams, milestones, and measurable outcomes. Lead high-priority strategic and cross-functional initiatives from definition through execution, bringing structure and momentum to complex or ambiguous problems. Support corporate development priorities, including strategic transactions, partnerships, investments, and other opportunities that accelerate MoonPay’s growth. Drive alignment across senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams, identifying dependencies, resolving blockers, and ensuring critical decisions and actions move forward. Build and continuously improve operating cadences, including prioritisation, planning, decision-making processes, and tracking against key objectives. Develop high-quality strategic analysis and materials that synthesize complex information, surface key trade-offs, and enable senior leadership to make informed decisions. 3. About You You have significant experience in a high-performance fintech or crypto business working in a business operations, strategy, corporate development, investing, consulting, or a similarly analytical and execution-focused role. You are an exceptional operator who can take ambiguous, complex problems, create structure, establish priorities, and drive work through to measurable outcomes. You have strong commercial and strategic judgment, with the ability to analyze opportunities, understand trade-offs, and connect individual initiatives to broader company objectives. You have experience influencing senior stakeholders and coordinating complex work across multiple functions without relying on formal authority. You thrive in fast-moving, high-accountability environments and are equally comfortable developing a strategic recommendation, diving into the details, and ensuring execution happens.

jobs.title: Business Manager
jobs.description: About BlaBlaCar BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely. Your Mission As a Business Manager, you will join a dynamic, fast-paced team at the heart of our growth, with a primary focus on scaling our Train business across Europe. This is a highly cross-functional role bridging strategy and execution. You will tackle everything from building strategies and managing rail carrier accounts to defining product priorities and exploring new business verticals. Reporting directly to the VP Business, you will be instrumental in making BlaBlaCar the ultimate multimodal marketplace. Your Responsibilities 🚀 Scale the Train Business Unit Expand & Grow: Drive the expansion of our train distribution business into new European markets and partner with local Growth Managers to boost sales in existing ones. Optimize Profitability: Develop and execute strategic initiatives to increase train business unit profitability, while continuously monitoring sales performance and costs. Partnership & Negotiation: Manage high-stakes relationships and lead negotiations with major rail carriers and GDS providers. Full working proficiency in English Fit with our BlaBlaPrinciples Thriving in a collaborative, fast-growing and innovative environment Ability to take ownership, aligned with business priorities and navigating in different contexts Nice to have: Familiarity with incident management platforms (e.g., Grafana IRM) is a bonus Experience working with Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Service Level Indicators (SLIs) Exposure to programming in Go or a strong interest in learning it. Experience in integrating Opentelemetry Backend services are built using multiple programming languages: while development skills aren't required, familiarity with object-oriented programming and scripting languages is an advantage. Familiarity with web/mobile testing tools or a strong curiosity to understand how software is tested at scale. What we have to offer Hybrid status for this role : 2-3 days at the Office 4 additional weeks on top of legal maternity/paternity leaves 50% healthcare coverage (Alan) Financial support for home office equipment Minimum 25 days holiday per year Local meal plan policy (Swile card) 50% transportation paid (Forfait Mobilité Durable) Free unlimited carpooling & bus rides Personal growth via trainings, mentorship, and internal mobility opportunities Employee Stock ownership plan Regular team building events 1 day off per year to test our product Interested in joining the ride? a 45-min video-call with one of our Talent Acquisition Manager, to get to know you, understand your career expectations and answer your questions a 60-min video-call with Damien Bertau, Hiring Manager, to discuss your experience and share more details about the team a 90-min system design interview with 2 team members to discuss about your technical expertise a 45-min video-call with Maxime Fouilleul, Head of Foundations, to get a wider vision of the department and its strategy Our hiring process lasts on average 25-30 days, offers usually come within 48 hours. Please note that one of these interviews will be onsite.

jobs.title: Stagiaire Communication & Relations Publiques (6 mois) - Paris, France
jobs.description: About BlaBlaCar BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely. Notre Mission Nous recherchons un(e) Stagiaire RP & Communication France pour rejoindre l'équipe PR & Comms de BlaBlaCar pour un stage de 6 mois débutant en Novembre ou Janvier 2026. Votre mission sera d'assister les deux PR & Comms Managers dans la promotion de BlaBlaCar auprès des médias (presse écrite et web, radio, TV, réseaux sociaux…). En tant que Stagiaire RP & Communication FR, vous serez rattaché(e) à la Senior Communication Manager France. Vous travaillerez sur un large éventail de sujets reflétant la diversité des activités de BlaBlaCar (covoiturage, bus, train), ce qui nécessitera une collaboration étroite avec les équipes respectives. Les projets de communication dont vous aurez la responsabilité seront tout aussi variés : tech, grand public, lifestyle et actualités basées sur la data. C'est pourquoi nous recherchons un esprit agile et curieux, capable de jongler entre plusieurs sujets et d'interagir avec divers départements simultanément dans un environnement dynamique. Vos responsabilités RP & Relations Médias (FR) : Filtrer et gérer les demandes médias entrantes (Aircall/Email), coordonner la collecte de données avec les équipes internes et l'agence de RP, et soutenir la logistique des interventions des porte-paroles. Communication Corporate & Reporting : Tenir à jour les documents de référence (trackers RP, KPI, présentations) et piloter la veille médiatique quotidienne pour partager en interne les retombées concernant BlaBlaCar ainsi que les actualités du secteur et de la concurrence. Newsroom & Optimisation SEO/GEO : Gérer la Newsroom et proposer des idées innovantes pour booster sa visibilité via le SEO et les nouvelles tendances de recherche par IA (GEO/LSO). Création de Contenu : Créer des contenus et carrousels LinkedIn engageants et mettre en forme les communiqués de presse en appliquant notre nouvelle identité de marque sur divers supports de communication. Vos qualifications Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles (FR & ANG) : Capacité à adapter le ton en fonction de l'audience (médias corporate, grand public, spécialisés…). Proactivité & Débrouillardise : Haut niveau d'autonomie avec une curiosité naturelle pour aller chercher l'information, tout en sachant quand demander conseil ou clarification. Bases en RP & Médias : Compréhension du fonctionnement du paysage médiatique et de la veille informationnelle. Maîtrise professionnelle de l'anglais. Adéquation avec nos "BlaBlaPrinciples" : S'épanouir dans un environnement collaboratif, innovant et en forte croissance. Capacité à prendre des responsabilités, en accord avec les priorités business. La détention d'une convention de stage délivrée par votre école ou université est obligatoire. Nous ne pourrons pas donner suite à votre candidature sans ce document. Ce que nous offrons Salaire : Entre 1000 € et 1200 € brut / mois Mode de travail hybride Un jour de congé par mois Titres-restaurant (carte Swile) Prise en charge des transports à 50 % (Forfait Mobilité Durable) Covoiturages et trajets en bus gratuits et illimités Développement personnel via des formations, du mentorat et des opportunités de mobilité interne Événements de team-building réguliers 1 jour de congé par an pour tester notre produit Prêt(e) à rejoindre l'aventure ? Un appel vidéo de 20 min avec Barbara Carnet, Talent Acquisition Manager, pour faire connaissance, comprendre vos attentes professionnelles et répondre à vos questions. Un appel vidéo de 45 min avec Clémence Perrard, Senior Communication Manager France, pour vous présenter et discuter de vos ambitions chez BlaBlaCar. Un exercice à distance pour évaluer vos compétences techniques. Un appel vidéo de 60 min avec Clémence & Rayan pour débriefer votre exercice. Notre processus de recrutement dure en moyenne 25 à 30 jours, et les offres sont généralement envoyées sous 48 heures. BlaBlaCar garantit l'égalité des chances. Nous célébrons la diversité et nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous ne répondez pas à 100 % des qualifications énumérées ci-dessus, dites-nous dans votre candidature pourquoi vous seriez tout de même un excellent profil pour ce rôle.

jobs.title: Stagiaire Marketing & Réseaux Sociaux France
jobs.description: À propos de BlaBlaCar BlaBlaCar est la première communauté mondiale de covoiturage et de voyage en bus, rassemblant plus de 26 millions de membres chaque année dans 40 pays. Nos 1000 collaborateurs, issus de plus de 50 nationalités, sont répartis dans 5 bureaux internationaux, avec 30 % de l’équipe en télétravail complet. Rejoindre BlaBlaCar, c’est participer à une aventure humaine et technologique unique, au service d’une mission : rendre la mobilité partagée plus accessible, conviviale et durable. Ta mission URGENT: Stage pour September 2026 Au sein de l’équipe Business & Marketing France, tu intégreras une équipe dédiée à la croissance de la communauté BlaBlaCar et tu travailleras sur des problématiques diverses et les différentes business unit de BlaBlaCar (covoiturage, bus, train). Tu intégreras l’équipe Marketing France et tu auras un rôle clé dans l’animation de nos réseaux sociaux pour engager la communauté BlaBlaCar. En lien avec l’agence spécialisée et en collaboration avec le Marketing Manager, tu contribueras à développer la notoriété et l’attractivité de la marque, avec un focus particulier sur TikTok et les nouvelles tendances sur les réseaux sociaux. Tu participeras aussi au déploiement de stratégies pour développer l’attractivité de BlaBlaCar auprès de la communauté étudiant.e.s.. Tes responsabilités Participer au développement de la stratégie de contenus pour nos réseaux sociaux (TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, etc.) en lien avec le Marketing Manager. Proposer, créer, publier du contenu engageant (vidéos, stories, formats innovants) et agir en tant que community manager Identifier et exploiter les tendances TikTok et les adapter aux codes de BlaBlaCar. Suivre et analyser les performances des campagnes (reach, engagement, conversions). Collaborer avec les équipes Brand, Design et CRM pour amplifier les campagnes. Participer à la veille concurrentielle et sectorielle : tendances en mobilité, usages des réseaux sociaux, bonnes pratiques de community management. Soutenir ponctuellement les campagnes marketing locales (CRM, activations offline/online). Ton profil Tu es actuellement en Master 1 ou 2 (École de commerce, Université ou équivalent). Tu disposes d’une première expérience en marketing ou en gestion de réseaux sociaux. Tu es passionné par les médias sociaux, avec une forte appétence pour TikTok et ses codes. Tu es créatif(ve), curieux(se), et force de proposition pour imaginer des contenus impactants. Tu es structuré(e), organisé(e) et capable de gérer plusieurs projets en parallèle. Tu t’exprimes parfaitement en français et tu es à l’aise en anglais (oral et écrit). Tu es basé(e) à Paris (ou prêt(e) à y travailler). Tu maîtrises les outils de travail classiques (Canva, Powerpoint, Excel…) et tu sauras vite t’adapter aux outils réseaux sociaux (Outils de planification, Montage Video…) Ce que nous offrons
